Over this timeframe, half of mined nickel threatens the top 10% of global land areas most critical for conserving biodiversity and storing carbon, but avoiding mining in these areas increases the risk of supply shortfalls. In addition, 53 to 60% of future supply comes from coastal mines, which threaten the top 10% of global priority areas for conserving marine biodiversity. While deep-sea resource development remains controversial, we show that a moratorium may increase reliance on nickel sourced from high-priority areas for conserving terrestrial and coastal marine biodiversity. Securing ecologically responsible nickel supply requires integrating terrestrial and marine conservation priorities to inform sourcing and mine development decisions, alongside efforts to mitigate unavoidable impacts, increase resource exploration and reduce long-term demand.
items.title_zh: 热带地区镍供应量的增长威胁到重点保护区
items.abstract_zh: 镍是低碳技术和不锈钢的关键金属，其全球需求不断增长，导致热带生物多样性保护区的镍矿开采量激增。我们利用全球逐矿供应情景模型，量化了满足未来脱碳镍需求与保护对实现生物多样性和气候目标至关重要的区域之间的权衡。镍红土矿（通常位于热带森林下方的近地表矿床）占2025年至2050年模型预测供应量的78%至83%。在此期间，开采的镍中有一半威胁到全球前10%对保护生物多样性和碳储存至关重要的陆地面积，但避免在这些区域开采会增加供应短缺的风险。此外，未来53%至60%的镍供应来自沿海矿区，这些矿区威胁到全球前10%的海洋生物多样性保护优先区域。尽管深海资源开发仍存在争议，但我们的研究表明，暂停开发可能会增加对来自高优先级区域镍矿的依赖，而这些区域对于保护陆地和沿海海洋生物多样性至关重要。确保生态友好的镍供应需要将陆地和海洋保护的优先事项纳入考量，以此指导镍矿的采购和开发决策，同时还需努力减轻不可避免的影响，加大资源勘探力度，并降低长期需求。

items.title: Tree community resource economics control soil food web multifunctionality
items.publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
items.abstract: Plants affect terrestrial ecosystem functioning by shaping microenvironments 1 and by providing the primary production that fuels energy flow into food webs 2 . However, how plant community properties affect ecosystem functioning via energy fluxes in food webs has been little studied 3,4 , especially for the soil food webs that channel most plant-derived energy 2,5 . Applying a food web energetics approach 6,7 , we show that the resource economics of dominant tree species control soil food web multifunctionality across European forests. Tree communities dominated by resource-acquisitive species promoted faster rates of multiple soil trophic functions than did communities dominated by resource-conservative species. These effects were primarily driven by higher-quality litter and warmer forest microclimates, leading to increased metabolic activity of soil organisms 8 . Accordingly, tree species composition explained a large portion of variation in soil food web multifunctionality, comparable to that explained by biogeographic differences among locations. By contrast, mixtures of three tree species had weakly negative effects relative to single-species stands, mostly due to shifts in energy channelling from living fine roots to litter and a cooling effect on forest microclimate. This occurred despite an overyielding effect in aboveground tree biomass production, suggesting contrasting diversity effects above- and belowground. Our findings emphasize the importance of plant functional traits related to resource economics as drivers of soil food web functioning 5,9 and demonstrate how climate-driven shifts in tree community composition may alter forest soil functioning.
items.title_zh: 树木群落资源经济控制土壤食物网多功能性
items.abstract_zh: 植物通过塑造微环境(1)和提供初级生产力来影响陆地生态系统的功能，而初级生产力又为食物网的能量流动提供动力(2)。然而，植物群落特性如何通过食物网中的能量流动影响生态系统功能的研究却很少(3,4)，尤其是对于承载大部分植物能量的土壤食物网而言(2,5)。我们运用食物网能量学方法(6,7)表明，优势树种的资源经济性控制着欧洲森林土壤食物网的多功能性。与以资源保守型树种为主的群落相比，以资源获取型树种为主的树种群落促进了多种土壤营养功能的快速进行。这些效应主要由更高质量的凋落物和更温暖的森林微气候驱动，从而提高了土壤生物的代谢活性(8)。因此，树种组成可以解释土壤食物网多功能性的大部分变异，其解释力与不同地点间的生物地理差异相当。相比之下，三种树木混交林相对于单一树种林分的影响较小，呈负面影响，这主要是由于能量从活根向凋落物转移，以及对森林微气候的降温效应所致。尽管地上树木生物量产量有所增加，但仍出现了这种负面影响，表明地上和地下生物多样性效应存在差异。我们的研究结果强调了与资源经济相关的植物功能性状作为土壤食物网功能驱动因素的重要性(5,9)，并展示了气候驱动的树木群落组成变化如何改变森林土壤功能。

items.title: Identifying marine climate refugia to advance climate-smart conservation
items.publisher: Elsevier BV
items.abstract: Climate change is impacting the ocean and the services it provides, but the rate of change is not spatially uniform. Some areas, known as marine climate refugia, are less impacted by climate change and, if conserved, can provide a promising climate adaptation strategy. In this review, we synthesize the processes that create refugia conditions and the scientific approaches used to identify them, which fall into three main categories: low climatic exposure, ecological resilience, and habitat suitability. These approaches are applied across levels of biological organization and multiple temporal and spatial scales, reflecting the dynamic nature of the ocean. We show that integrating these approaches into conservation and management can support climate-smart strategies to enhance ocean resilience and biodiversity under intensifying climate threats.
items.title_zh: 识别海洋气候避难所，以推进气候智能型保护
items.abstract_zh: 气候变化正在影响海洋及其提供的服务，但变化速度并非空间均匀分布。一些被称为海洋气候避难所的区域受气候变化的影响较小，如果加以保护，可以成为一种极具前景的气候适应策略。本文综述了形成避难所条件的过程以及用于识别避难所的科学方法，这些方法主要分为三大类：低气候暴露度、生态韧性和栖息地适宜性。这些方法应用于不同的生物组织层级以及多个时空尺度，反映了海洋的动态特性。我们指出，将这些方法融入保护和管理中，可以支持气候智能型策略，从而在日益加剧的气候威胁下增强海洋的韧性和生物多样性。

items.title: Solving science conundrums in the climate-nature-equity polycrisis with integrated transformative scenarios
items.publisher: Elsevier BV
items.abstract: Addressing the intertwined climate, biodiversity, and equity crises requires transformative societal change. Yet the scenario frameworks and models used to explore future pathways often reproduce existing institutions, governance systems, and social structures, limiting their ability to imagine more sustainable and just futures. A key gap is the lack of approaches that can identify and evaluate transformative actions while accounting for systemic inequities in implementation. Here, we argue that integrating climate and biodiversity knowledge across the natural sciences, social sciences, and humanities, together with stakeholders and diverse knowledge holders, can support the development of normative scenarios and models for just and sustainable Earth system futures. We outline a research agenda, highlight emerging examples of this shift, and identify the coalitions and institutional changes needed to advance it. More inclusive scenarios and modeling tools are essential for foregrounding equitable solution pathways and informing decisions about collective futures.
items.title_zh: 利用综合转型情景解决气候-自然-公平多重危机中的科学难题
items.abstract_zh: 应对相互交织的气候、生物多样性和公平危机需要变革性的社会变革。然而，用于探索未来路径的情景框架和模型往往复制了现有的制度、治理体系和社会结构，限制了它们构想更可持续、更公正的未来的能力。一个关键的缺口在于缺乏能够在考虑实施过程中系统性不平等的情况下，识别和评估变革性行动的方法。本文认为，整合自然科学、社会科学和人文学科的气候和生物多样性知识，并与利益相关者和多元知识持有者合作，可以支持构建公正、可持续的地球系统未来的规范性情景和模型。我们概述了一项研究议程，重点介绍了这一转变的新兴实例，并指出了推进这一转变所需的联盟和制度变革。更具包容性的情景和建模工具对于凸显公平的解决方案路径以及为集体未来决策提供信息至关重要。

items.title: Antarctic biodiversity can improve estimates of ice-sheet collapse and future sea-level rise
items.publisher: Elsevier BV
items.title_zh: 南极生物多样性有助于提高对冰盖崩塌和未来海平面上升的估算精度

items.title: Evolving nature-based solutions for urban resilience
items.publisher: American Association for the Advancement of Science (AAAS)
items.abstract: Despite growing investments in nature-based solutions for urban resilience, their design often overlooks a fundamental biological process: evolution. Populations of organisms that sustain nature-based solutions are dynamic and can evolve over time. Rapid evolutionary changes, driven by urban environmental stressors, such as pollution, climate extremes, and habitat fragmentation, can reshape species’ traits, alter interactions, and shift ecosystem functions. We synthesize evidence of evolutionary change across systems that serve as nature-based solutions in urban contexts and show how evolutionary processes can enhance or undermine their performance. We propose four testable hypotheses linking evolutionary dynamics to nature-based solutions and outline design strategies to maintain adaptive potential. Integrating evolution into nature-based solutions is essential to ensure long-term and efficient functionality under accelerating environmental change.
items.title_zh: 不断发展的基于自然的城市韧性解决方案
items.abstract_zh: 尽管对基于自然的城市韧性解决方案的投资不断增长，但这些方案的设计往往忽略了一个基本的生物学过程：进化。维持这些解决方案的生物种群是动态的，并且会随着时间的推移而进化。由污染、极端气候和栖息地破碎化等城市环境压力因素驱动的快速进化变化，可以重塑物种特征、改变相互作用并转变生态系统功能。我们综合分析了在城市环境中作为基于自然的解决方案的系统所发生的进化变化证据，并展示了进化过程如何增强或削弱这些解决方案的性能。我们提出了四个可检验的假设，将进化动力学与基于自然的解决方案联系起来，并概述了维持其适应潜力的设计策略。将进化融入基于自然的解决方案对于确保其在加速变化的环境条件下长期高效运行至关重要。

items.title: Trade-offs between nature and people in Ethiopia’s protected areas demonstrate challenges in translating global conservation targets into national realities
items.publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
items.abstract: Achieving global biodiversity targets, such as the commitment to conserve 30% of the planet by 2030, depends on the ability of individual countries to translate targets into reality. While there has long been recognition that protected areas can bring costs as well as benefits, the implications of this for delivery of global targets have not been fully explored. We focus on Ethiopia, a country supporting globally important biodiversity but facing substantial poverty challenges. We characterize the extent and representativeness of Ethiopia’s protected area network, demonstrating that a threefold expansion—particularly into ecoregions with higher opportunity cost—would be required to meet the Kunming–Montreal Global Biodiversity Framework Target 3. Using a quasi-experimental approach (accounting for known confounders and exploring sensitivity to potential unobserved confounders), we show that the existing protected area network has reduced forest loss and agricultural expansion, and helped to maintain grasslands. Yet, this has brought social wellbeing costs equivalent to 3.9 million fewer household-months of adequate food. Surveys show that national conservation stakeholders recognize these challenges and prioritize improving effectiveness of the existing network over expansion. Our findings highlight that trade-offs between environmental and social outcomes are not simply challenges to be managed, but are central to whether global biodiversity commitments can be delivered.
items.title_zh: 埃塞俄比亚保护区内人与自然之间的权衡取舍，凸显了将全球保护目标转化为国家现实所面临的挑战
items.abstract_zh: 实现全球生物多样性目标，例如到2030年保护地球30%的面积，取决于各国将目标转化为现实的能力。虽然人们早已认识到保护区既有益处也有弊端，但其对实现全球目标的影响尚未得到充分探讨。我们以埃塞俄比亚为例，该国拥有重要的全球生物多样性，但同时也面临着严峻的贫困挑战。我们分析了埃塞俄比亚保护区网络的规模和代表性，并指出，要实现昆明-蒙特利尔全球生物多样性框架目标3，保护区网络需要扩大三倍，尤其是在机会成本较高的生态区域。我们采用准实验方法（考虑已知混杂因素并探索对潜在未观察到的混杂因素的敏感性），结果表明，现有的保护区网络减少了森林损失和农业扩张，并有助于维护草原。然而，这也带来了相当于390万个家庭月均充足食物摄入量减少的社会福祉损失。调查显示，各国自然保护利益相关者认识到这些挑战，并将提高现有网络的有效性置于扩张之上。我们的研究结果强调，环境和社会效益之间的权衡取舍不仅仅是需要应对的挑战，更是能否兑现全球生物多样性承诺的关键所在。

items.title: Social implications of the 30×30 global conservation target
items.publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
items.abstract: Target 3 of the Kunming-Montreal Global Biodiversity Framework aims to increase global protected and conserved area coverage to at least 30% by 2030. The impact on people, whether positive or negative, will depend on the social context of additional areas and how they are governed and managed. Here, we show that Target 3 could affect large and socially diverse populations under different implementation scenarios. Nearly half the human population lives within 10 km of areas included in a scenario maximising biodiversity representation. Four percent live near areas included in an Indigenous and traditional territories-based scenario, including many in areas with low Human Development Index scores (74%) and high participation in wild harvesting (91%). A scenario prioritising nature’s contributions to people is intermediate on all measures. Our results demonstrate that Target 3 is a highly ambitious social as well as ecological target, requiring an equally ambitious commitment to development funding and support for local residents.
items.title_zh: 全球保护目标的社会影响
items.abstract_zh: 《昆明-蒙特利尔全球生物多样性框架》目标3旨在到2030年将全球保护区和保育区覆盖率提高到至少30%。对人类的影响，无论是积极的还是消极的，都将取决于新增区域的社会背景以及它们的治理和管理方式。本文表明，在不同的实施情景下，目标3可能会对庞大且社会结构多元化的人群产生影响。在最大化生物多样性代表性的情景下，近一半的人口居住在距离保护区10公里范围内。4%的人口居住在基于原住民和传统领土的情景下，其中包括许多居住在人类发展指数得分较低（74%）且野生采集参与度较高（91%）的地区的人口。优先考虑自然对人类贡献的情景在所有指标上都处于中间水平。我们的研究结果表明，目标3是一项雄心勃勃的社会和生态目标，需要对发展资金和当地居民的支持做出同样雄心勃勃的承诺。

items.title: Hidden patterns in fauna compensation values in European biodiversity legislation
items.publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
items.abstract: Biodiversity laws in several European countries rely on official species-level price lists for fauna to enable compensation for biodiversity damage. However, the methods underlying these values are often opaque and poorly justified, raising concerns about consistency, fairness and ecological relevance. To gain insights into the revealed public regulatory patterns embedded in these mechanisms, we investigate how monetary compensation values are assigned to fauna in European biodiversity legislation and what factors influence these values. Here we show that species-level values are implicitly guided by biological traits and taxonomic biases, based on a dataset of 9,971 species across 24 countries. Our analysis reveals that mammals and birds receive disproportionately higher values, while traits such as generation length and protection status also significantly influence values. These findings reveal hidden criteria that shape regulatory decisions and enhance our understanding of conservation priorities. We recommend integrating systematic, science-based criteria into legal valuation practices, supported by collaboration between conservation scientists and legal practitioners.
items.title_zh: 欧洲生物多样性立法中动物补偿价值的隐藏模式
items.abstract_zh: 欧洲多个国家的生物多样性法律依赖于官方的物种级动物价格清单，以便对生物多样性损害进行补偿。然而，这些价值评估方法往往不透明且缺乏充分的论证，引发了人们对一致性、公平性和生态相关性的担忧。为了深入了解这些机制中隐含的公共监管模式，我们研究了欧洲生物多样性立法中如何为动物赋予货币补偿价值，以及哪些因素会影响这些价值。基于涵盖24个国家9971个物种的数据集，我们发现物种级价值的确定隐含地受到生物特征和分类学偏见的影响。我们的分析表明，哺乳动物和鸟类获得的价值不成比例地高，而世代长度和保护状况等特征也显著影响价值。这些发现揭示了影响监管决策的隐性标准，并加深了我们对保护优先事项的理解。我们建议将系统性的、基于科学的标准纳入法律估值实践，并支持保护科学家和法律从业人员之间的合作。

items.title: Limiting future warming reduces drought exposure for terrestrial vertebrates
items.publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
items.abstract: Ambitious conservation efforts are needed to curb biodiversity loss as drought severity intensifies globally. Here, we assess the exposure of resident terrestrial vertebrates within global biodiversity hotspots to drought severity surpassing the extremes experienced during their pre-industrial history. We show that 22.5% of threatened terrestrial vertebrates (especially reptiles and amphibians) have recently experienced drought severity exceeding their historical extremes across at least half of their current geographic range. Under an intermediate greenhouse gas emission scenario (Shared Socioeconomic Pathway 2–4.5), this proportion is projected to reach 36.5% by the latter half of the 21st century, with mid-latitude dryland biodiversity hotspots facing the most severe drought exposure. Importantly, a low-warming future (Shared Socioeconomic Pathway 1–2.6) will reduce exposure estimates of species by 8.5% compared to Shared Socioeconomic Pathway 2–4.5, highlighting the urgency of ambitious climate mitigation. However, as future drought exposure is projected to increase across most biodiversity hotspots, and many exposed regions face inadequate protection and substantial social burdens, expanding adaptive conservation without compromising local well-being is essential. Our findings offer spatial guidance for prioritizing conservation and adaptive strategies in biodiversity hotspots, contributing to global biodiversity targets.
items.title_zh: 限制未来升温可以减少陆生脊椎动物遭受干旱的风险
items.abstract_zh: 随着全球干旱加剧，亟需采取雄心勃勃的保护措施来遏制生物多样性丧失。本文评估了全球生物多样性热点地区陆生脊椎动物所面临的干旱程度，这些干旱程度已超过其工业化前历史上的极端水平。研究表明，22.5%的受威胁陆生脊椎动物（尤其是爬行动物和两栖动物）近期在其至少一半的现有地理分布范围内经历了超过历史极端水平的干旱。在中等温室气体排放情景（共享社会经济路径2-4.5）下，预计到21世纪下半叶，这一比例将达到36.5%，其中中纬度干旱生物多样性热点地区将面临最严重的干旱威胁。值得注意的是，与共享社会经济路径2-4.5相比，低升温未来（共享社会经济路径1-2.6）将使物种暴露程度估计值降低8.5%，这凸显了采取雄心勃勃的气候减缓措施的紧迫性。然而，由于预计未来大多数生物多样性热点地区的干旱暴露程度将会增加，而且许多暴露地区面临保护不足和沉重的社会负担，因此在不损害当地居民福祉的前提下扩大适应性保护至关重要。我们的研究结果为在生物多样性热点地区优先制定保护和适应性策略提供了空间指导，有助于实现全球生物多样性目标。

items.title: Enduring cultural legacies affect Euro-American wildlife values
items.publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
items.abstract: Social values shape biodiversity conservation success. Yet information is lacking on how values form, change and adapt people to their environment. Our 33-nation survey in 2021–2023 (n = 18,477) explored the effect of the institutions of European colonization on present-day values towards wildlife in the Americas. Here we found mutualism values (seeing wildlife as part of one’s social community) prevail in Iberian-origin Latin American countries, whereas domination values (seeing wildlife as a resource for human use) are more prevalent in British-origin North American countries. Multilevel analysis showed significant country-level effects of colonial institution (for example, colonial origin, Protestant versus Catholic religious cultures) and endowment (for example, pre-colonial population density, Indigenous ancestry, settler mortality) factors on wildlife values in the Americas. The strong mutualism emphasis in Latin America appears to be consistent with acculturation between the compatible ideologies of Indigenous peoples and the Iberian colonizers. The effectiveness of wildlife institutions and policies will depend on their congruence with the social values of publics being served. Little is known about how values emerge, evolve and affect people’s relation with their natural environment. A study now sheds light on the influence of the institutions of European colonization on present-day values towards wildlife in the Americas.
items.title_zh: 持久的文化遗产影响着人们对欧美野生动物的价值观

items.title: Larger forest patches have greater per-area productivity
items.publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
items.abstract: Forest fragmentation could reduce carbon sequestration beyond losses caused by declining forest area alone, if smaller patches are intrinsically less productive per unit area than larger ones. Here we analyse 17 million forest patches across the conterminous USA and show that per-area net primary productivity increases systematically with patch size. A hectare embedded within a ~100,000 km 2 forest is, on average, 38% more productive than an isolated hectare under comparable environmental conditions. Counterfactual analyses indicate that existing fragmentation has already reduced total annual forest productivity across the conterminous USA by 0.16 GtC yr −1 or 14% relative to an upper-bound configuration of large, contiguous forests. Random forest models identify patch size as a stronger predictor of net primary productivity than topographic and soil variables. Extending the analysis globally with coarser-resolution data, we find consistent positive relationships between patch size and per-area productivity for both net and gross primary productivity. These results demonstrate that forest fragmentation can reduce carbon sequestration without net forest-area loss, highlighting the need to account for fragmentation—not just forest cover—in climate mitigation strategies.
items.title_zh: 面积较大的林地具有更高的单位面积生产力
items.abstract_zh: 如果较小的林斑本身单位面积生产力就低于较大的林斑，那么森林破碎化造成的碳固存损失可能超过森林面积减少本身造成的损失。本文分析了美国本土1700万个森林斑块，结果表明单位面积净初级生产力随斑块面积的增大而系统性地增加。在10万平方公里森林中嵌入的一公顷林斑，其生产力平均比在相似环境条件下孤立的一公顷林斑高出38%。反事实分析表明，现有的森林破碎化已经使美国本土的年度森林总生产力减少了0.16亿吨碳/年，相当于相对于大型连片森林的上限配置降低了14%。随机森林模型表明，斑块大小比地形和土壤变量更能有效地预测净初级生产力。将分析扩展到全球范围，并使用分辨率更低的数据，我们发现斑块大小与单位面积净初级生产力和总初级生产力之间均存在一致的正相关关系。这些结果表明，森林破碎化可能会减少碳固存，而不会造成森林面积净损失，这凸显了在气候减缓战略中需要考虑森林破碎化（而不仅仅是森林覆盖）的必要性。

items.title: Integrating Earth history into phylogenetic diversification models
items.publisher: Elsevier BV
items.title_zh: 将地球历史整合到系统发育多样化模型中

items.title: Toward climate-smart rewilding: An integrated framework for biodiversity, climate change, and society
items.publisher: Elsevier BV
items.abstract: ABSTRACT The UN Decade on Ecosystem Restoration and the Kunming-Montreal Global Biodiversity Framework aim to restore 30% of degraded ecosystems. Both the IPCC and IPBES highlight the crucial role of ecosystem restoration in addressing the interconnected crises of climate change and biodiversity loss. One key restoration strategy is rewilding, which enhances ecosystem complexity with minimal human intervention. While traditional rewilding strategies often focus on benefits for biodiversity, we propose a climate-smart rewilding framework as a new approach designed to deliver climate benefits alongside biodiversity restoration. This framework seeks to integrate biodiversity, climate change adaptation and mitigation, as well as socio-economic benefits and trade-offs. We illustrate how this framework can be utilized to identify areas across Europe where rewilding could increase carbon sequestration, enhance species’ abilities to adapt to the velocity of climate change, and maximize wildlife-watching benefits while minimizing the costs associated with livestock-wildlife conflict. Finally, we acknowledge some limitations of climate-smart rewilding, but we argue that its adaptability and low cost render it a promising solution to the challenges facing Europe and beyond.
items.title_zh: 迈向气候智能型自然恢复：生物多样性、气候变化和社会的综合框架
items.abstract_zh: 《昆明-蒙特利尔全球生物多样性框架》呼吁到2030年恢复至少30%的退化生态系统，而政府间气候变化专门委员会（IPCC）和生物多样性与生态系统服务政府间科学政策平台（IPBES）则强调恢复是应对气候变化和生物多样性丧失的核心。“野化”是指通过最小程度的人为干预来促进自我维持的复杂生态系统，它已成为一种重要的恢复策略，但其在减缓气候变化方面的潜力往往未得到充分挖掘。本文提出了一种气候智能型野化框架，该框架明确地将生物多样性恢复与气候减缓、气候适应和社会经济因素相结合。我们以欧洲为例，分析了碳固存、生态系统对气候变化的适应能力、野生动物旅游机遇以及牲畜与捕食者冲突风险之间潜在的协同作用和权衡取舍。我们认为，这一综合框架为识别和评估能够在区域和大陆尺度上带来多重效益的恢复策略提供了切实可行的基础。

items.title: Interacting effects of human presence and landscape modification on birds and mammals
items.publisher: American Association for the Advancement of Science (AAAS)
items.abstract: Sustainable human–wildlife coexistence requires a mechanistic understanding of the many ways that humans affect animals. However, progress is hampered by the lack of accessible data measuring the dynamic presence of people. Here, we leverage mobile-device data to disentangle how human presence and landscape modification differentially influence the use of geographic and environmental space for 37 mammal and bird species across the United States. Human presence affected more than 65% of species, with substantial variation across species. For ~60% of species that responded to human activities, the effects were interdependent—animals tended to react more strongly to human presence in less modified habitats. Our results demonstrate that human presence and landscape modification have complex combined effects on wildlife, which need to be considered for effective management.
items.title_zh: 人类活动和景观改造对鸟类和哺乳动物的交互影响
items.abstract_zh: 可持续的人兽共存需要对人类影响动物的多种方式进行机制性理解。然而，由于缺乏可获取的、用于衡量人类动态存在的数据，相关研究进展受到阻碍。本文利用移动设备数据，分析了人类活动和景观改造如何以不同的方式影响美国37种哺乳动物和鸟类对地理和环境空间的利用。人类活动影响了超过65%的物种，且不同物种间的影响差异显著。在对人类活动有反应的物种中，有60%的物种受到的影响是相互依存的——动物在受人类活动影响较小的栖息地中往往对人类活动的反应更为强烈。我们的研究结果表明，人类活动和景观改造对野生动物具有复杂的综合影响，在进行有效管理时必须考虑这些因素。

items.title: Biogeographic processes underlying global patterns of plant diversity
items.publisher: American Association for the Advancement of Science (AAAS)
items.abstract: The uneven global distribution of plant diversity remains a fundamental question in biogeography. Using dated phylogenies of >300,000 plant species and ancestral biogeographical stochastic mapping, we show that in situ speciation is the predominant process underlying extant plant diversity and accounts for 78% of biogeographic events across realms. The Neotropic contributed 37% of in situ speciation, likely owing to its role as a center of species diversification. Dispersal between realms was less frequent (16% of events) but facilitated floristic exchanges, especially in the Eastern Hemisphere. Extinction was least frequent but more pronounced in East Asia. These findings support the tropical conservatism hypothesis in which many clades originated in the tropics and only recently expanded into temperate zones, where limited time and biome conservatism have restricted speciation and diversity.
items.title_zh: 植物多样性全球格局背后的生物地理过程
items.abstract_zh: 植物多样性的全球分布不均仍然是生物地理学中的一个基本问题。我们利用超过30万种植物的年代测定系统发育树和祖先生物地理随机映射，发现原位物种形成是现存植物多样性的主要驱动过程，占各生物地理区生物地理事件的78%。新热带区贡献了37%的原位物种形成，这可能与其作为物种多样化中心的作用有关。跨生物地理区的扩散频率较低（占事件的16%），但促进了植物区系的交流，尤其是在东半球。灭绝事件发生频率最低，但在东亚地区更为显著。这些发现支持热带保守性假说，该假说认为许多植物分支起源于热带地区，只是在近期才扩展到温带地区，而有限的时间和生物群落的保守性限制了温带地区的物种形成和多样性。

items.title: Synthetic control methods enable stronger causal inference using participatory science data in cities
items.publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
items.abstract: Urban environments pose unique challenges for understanding drivers of biodiversity change, as fragmented land ownership makes traditional biodiversity monitoring and randomized experiments logistically difficult. While participatory science platforms such as iNaturalist offer a promising data source by providing extensive biodiversity data from urban areas, inferring causality remains challenging because of confounding factors in observational data. To leverage these data advances, we offer a framework that combines records from iNaturalist with synthetic-control methods, a quasi-experimental approach. We demonstrate this approach in a case study assessing the impact of Hurricane Ida (2021) on the number of research-grade iNaturalist bee observations, used as a proxy for bee abundance, in Philadelphia, USA. The synthetic control estimated a 15.5-20.9% decline in bee observations in the 2 years post-event. By contrast, three conventional ecological analyses-an interrupted time-series regression, before-after comparison and a before-after control impact design-failed to detect this decline. Synthetic-control methods offer a powerful tool for estimating city-wide biodiversity responses to climate events and policy interventions, enhancing the utility of participatory science data for urban ecology.
items.title_zh: 合成控制方法能够利用城市中的参与式科学数据进行更强的因果推断
items.abstract_zh: 城市环境给理解生物多样性变化的驱动因素带来了独特的挑战，因为土地所有权的分散使得传统的生物多样性监测和随机实验在后勤方面难以开展。虽然诸如iNaturalist之类的参与式科学平台提供了来自城市地区的大量生物多样性数据，为数据来源提供了广阔的前景，但由于观测数据中存在混杂因素，推断因果关系仍然具有挑战性。为了充分利用这些数据优势，我们提出了一种框架，将iNaturalist的记录与合成对照方法（一种准实验方法）相结合。我们通过一个案例研究来展示这种方法，该研究评估了2021年飓风艾达对美国费城iNaturalist平台上研究级蜜蜂观测数量（用作蜜蜂丰度的指标）的影响。合成对照估计，飓风过后两年内，蜜蜂观测数量下降了15.5%至20.9%。相比之下，三种传统的生态学分析方法——中断时间序列回归、前后对比分析和前后对照影响设计——均未能检测到这种下降趋势。合成控制方法为评估城市生物多样性对气候事件和政策干预的响应提供了一种强有力的工具，从而增强了参与式科学数据在城市生态学中的应用价值。

items.title: Warming erodes climate connectivity for terrestrial vertebrates
items.publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
items.abstract: Although climate-driven connectivity plays a critical role in linking discrete habitats, it remains unclear whether it can continue to support the migration and adaptation of terrestrial vertebrates under global warming. Here we develop a metric to consider this connectivity (functional effectiveness of climate connectivity), which quantifies the contribution of climate corridors in linking suitable areas for specific biological communities. We show that, with warming exceeding 4 °C, approximately 77.9% of the global land area is projected to experience a decline in functional effectiveness of climate connectivity during 2061–2080, greatly restricting the range of suitable areas accessible to species. As warming intensifies, disruptions to climate connectivity are expected to increasingly undermine the integrity of habitat networks, raising the risk of ecological isolation and local biodiversity loss. Our findings highlight regions most vulnerable to the erosion of climate connectivity, providing guidance for aligning conservation priorities and adaptive management. The authors consider connectivity—specifically, the functional effectiveness of climate connectivity (FECC)—under climate change. Under high emissions (SSP5-8.5), FECC is projected to decline across 77% of the global land area by 2061–2080, risking ecological isolation and subsequent biodiversity loss.
items.title_zh: 气候变暖削弱了陆生脊椎动物的气候连通性

items.title: Advancing biodiversity through poverty solutions
items.publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
items.abstract: Forests provide several ecosystem services that support the livelihoods of millions of forest-dependent people in lower- and middle-income countries. Provisioning of ecosystem services is directly linked to the maintenance of forest biodiversity, which in turn is influenced by human activities. We leveraged a unique dataset of plot-level tree species data from 322 tropical community forests to analyse the joint effects of demographic, socioeconomic and institutional factors on forest biodiversity, as such impacts have been rarely assessed simultaneously. We find that percentage of poor households and community reliance on fuelwood are associated with lower richness. Over time, forests in areas with higher population density and increasing numbers of poor households experienced declines in local species richness, with dominant species being the most affected. In contrast, forests in areas where households have increased their reliance on subsistence crops are associated with positive changes in species richness and these changes took place across rare, common and dominant species. Social and institutional factors (livestock presence and governance arrangements) showed no association with species richness losses or gains over time. Our analyses suggest that interventions aimed at reducing poverty may create positive effects on community forest diversity and thus on the ecosystem services these forests provide. Forest biodiversity is linked, in many cases, to the myriad ecosystem services that support the livelihoods of human populations. Authors here examine the demographic, socioeconomic and institutional variables that impact forest biodiversity across 322 tropical forests.
items.title_zh: 通过消除贫困来促进生物多样性

items.title: Biodiversity and habitat complexity buffer the destabilizing effects of anthropogenic activities on riverine fish communities
items.publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
items.abstract: Riverine fish communities are essential for the functioning of aquatic ecosystems and provide important ecosystem services for fisheries. Yet, anthropogenic environmental changes pose threats to fish communities and result in population collapses and reduced yields, underscoring the need to understand their stability from local to regional scales. In this study, we leverage long-term observational data of riverine fish communities in 108 hydrological basins across the globe to determine how anthropogenic activity, biodiversity, and habitat complexity jointly influence riverine fish community stability (i.e., temporal invariability of total fish abundance) at the site and basin scales. Our analyses show that anthropogenic activities represented by human footprint index decrease fish community stability across spatial scales; however, biodiversity and habitat complexity buffer these destabilizing effects by providing insurance effects at both site and basin scales. Specifically, biodiversity has consistently stabilizing effects across scales through enhancing the asynchrony within and/or among fish communities. At the basin scale, greater habitat area increases gamma stability by enhancing spatial community asynchrony. Our findings underscore the importance of conserving both fish biodiversity and habitat complexity to sustain the stability of riverine fish communities in the Anthropocene.
items.title_zh: 生物多样性和栖息地复杂性能够缓冲人类活动对河流鱼类群落的破坏性影响
items.abstract_zh: 河流鱼类群落对水生生态系统的功能至关重要，并为渔业提供重要的生态系统服务。然而，人为环境变化对鱼类群落构成威胁，导致种群崩溃和产量下降，凸显了从局部到区域尺度了解其稳定性的必要性。本研究利用全球108个流域河流鱼类群落的长期观测数据，探讨了人为活动、生物多样性和栖息地复杂性如何共同影响河流鱼类群落的稳定性（即鱼类总丰度的时空稳定性），并分别在流域尺度上进行分析。分析结果表明，以人类足迹指数为代表的人为活动会降低鱼类群落在不同空间尺度上的稳定性；然而，生物多样性和栖息地复杂性通过在流域尺度上提供保障作用，缓冲了这些不稳定影响。具体而言，生物多样性通过增强鱼类群落内部和/或群落间的异步性，在不同尺度上持续发挥稳定作用。在流域尺度上，更大的栖息地面积通过增强空间群落异步性来提高γ稳定性。我们的研究结果强调了保护鱼类生物多样性和栖息地复杂性对于在人类世维持河流鱼类群落稳定性的重要性。

items.title: Seabird range contraction and dispersal under climate change
items.publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
items.abstract: Many marine ectotherms have responded to local warming through body-size reductions and dispersal to optimal environments. However, whether endothermic marine species, such as seabirds, exhibit similar responses remains unclear owing to gaps in literature that hinder comprehensive global assessments. Here we show that globally distributed seabirds (albatrosses, petrels, shearwaters and storm petrels) facing rapid historical climate change responded with changes in geographic range size rather than body mass. In addition, under higher rates of climate change, species’ ranges contracted most, forcing these species to disperse longer distances. These historical inferences align with expected responses to modern climate change, as over 70% of extant species contract their ranges and disperse farther under a climate scenario leading to severe warming by 2100. These results underscore the urgent need to integrate range dynamics into conservation strategies and reveal that the rate of climate change poses the greatest threat to seabird diversity.
items.title_zh: 气候变化导致海鸟活动范围缩小和扩散
items.abstract_zh: 许多海洋变温动物通过缩小体型和扩散到更适宜的环境中来应对局部变暖。然而，由于文献资料的匮乏阻碍了全面的全球评估，内温海洋物种（例如海鸟）是否表现出类似的响应仍不清楚。本文研究表明，面对快速的历史气候变化，全球分布的海鸟（信天翁、海燕、鹱和暴风海燕）的响应体现在地理分布范围的变化，而非体型的变化。此外，在气候变化速率较高的情况下，物种的分布范围缩小最为显著，迫使这些物种进行更远距离的扩散。这些历史推断与对现代气候变化的预期响应相符，因为在2100年导致严重变暖的气候情景下，超过70%的现存物种的分布范围将会缩小，并且扩散距离也会更远。这些结果强调了将分布范围动态纳入保护策略的迫切性，并揭示了气候变化速率对海鸟多样性构成的最大威胁。

items.title: Improved forest protection at Chinese heritage relic sites
items.publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
items.abstract: Rapid deforestation and accelerating human pressures throughout the twentieth century reshaped forest landscapes worldwide, raising urgent questions about the role of heritage relics in ecological resilience. We compiled a national database of 363,282 heritage relic sites in China, including 307,666 heritage trees, 8,155 traditional villages, 5,060 cultural heritage sites and 42,401 religious sites, and integrated it with historical forest coverage data (1900–2020) and a high-resolution human footprint index (2020). Here, using geostatistical analysis and machine learning, we show that heritage relics function as long-term refugia, preserving forests during periods of deforestation and enhancing recovery during large-scale restoration. Heritage trees and traditional villages are associated with higher forest coverage and faster regeneration than religious or cultural heritage sites, especially in southern China and in regions of lower anthropogenic pressure. Yet these protective effects diminish as human footprints intensify, revealing the conditional resilience of relic-associated forests. Our findings demonstrate that biocultural heritage is not merely a repository of cultural values but also a dynamic ecological infrastructure that sustains biodiversity and ecosystem services over centuries. Integrating relic protection into conservation strategies offers an underused pathway for achieving global biodiversity and sustainability targets, including the Kunming–Montreal global biodiversity framework and the sustainable development goals. Deforestation over the past century represents a crucial challenge for biodiversity conservation, but whether biocultural sites can improve conservation outcomes is still unclear. This study examines biocultural sites across China to test how these influence forest conservation outcomes.
items.title_zh: 加强对中国文物遗址的森林保护

items.title: Human shielding from wolves facilitates jackal expansion across Europe
items.publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
items.abstract: Among the many pathways through which human activity can shape biodiversity patterns, modification of biotic interactions tends to be overlooked. Here we show how interacting anthropogenic, biotic and abiotic factors drive the continental-scale expansion of a highly adaptive mesocarnivore, the golden jackal. Using a dataset of playback surveys conducted across Europe, we find that the presence of an apex predator, the grey wolf, is the primary factor limiting jackal occurrence. However, a human presence acts as a shield that considerably reduces the strength of wolf suppression and provides jackals refuge near people. Our fitted distribution model predicts that jackals have the potential to expand until they occupy 75% of the continent, almost six times larger than their current range. The ongoing recovery of wolves in Europe could reduce suitable areas for expanding jackals by up to 18% in the near future, but a persistent human-shield effect, coupled with climate warming and landscape modification, is expected to sustain continued jackal expansion across the continent. Our results illustrate how cascading anthropogenic impacts can hamper the ecological benefits provided by apex predator recovery. Human-driven declines of top predators can have cascading effects on other species. Here the authors show that the loss of wolves from a landscape has facilitated the spread of the golden jackal through Europe and model the potential future colonization of this species.
items.title_zh: 人类对狼的保护反而促进了豺在欧洲的扩张

items.title: The fate of mountain biodiversity in a warming world
items.publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
items.abstract: Mountains are home to some of the most spectacular biodiversity on Earth, but mountain species are thought to be especially vulnerable to climate change-driven extinctions. However, mountains can also be refugia, providing a plethora of habitats and climates that allow species to persist despite climate change. In this Review, we examine how mountain species have responded to past and ongoing warming to assess their vulnerability and resilience to climate change. We highlight three main take-home messages. First, mountain species largely showed resilience in response to Quaternary warming: species showed variable responses over short timescales, but communities generally tracked temperature changes over longer timescales, with little evidence of climate-driven extinctions. Second, mountain species show a mix of vulnerability and resilience in response to modern anthropogenic warming: species show variable elevational range changes, and there are cases of mountaintop extirpations. Third, vulnerability to modern climate change appears to be most pronounced in tropical species, high-elevation species and species whose ecological traits are associated with greater climate exposure. Both Quaternary and modern data reveal that mountain species can be much more resilient than often assumed by standard forecasting approaches, but accumulating evidence suggests many tropical mountain species are vulnerable to current warming. Species living on mountains are thought to be especially vulnerable to ongoing climate change. This Review explores past and present responses of mountaintop species to climate warming to help to understand mountain species’ vulnerabilities and resilience to future warming.
items.title_zh: 气候变暖世界中山地生物多样性的命运

items.title: Darkness and body size shaped end-Cretaceous marine extinction patterns
items.publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
items.abstract: The Chicxulub asteroid impact at the Cretaceous–Paleogene (K–Pg) boundary (66 Ma) is thought to have caused the extinction of around 75% of species in the fossil record by triggering catastrophic environmental changes 1 . However, despite decades of research, the mechanisms linking the environmental changes to the selective extinction patterns observed in the marine fossil record remain unresolved. Here we use a global trait-based ecosystem model 2,3 to establish this causality for the marine plankton community beyond the fossilized groups. Our model simulates diversity dynamics during the initial 100 years after the K–Pg boundary and represents explicitly extinction based on biomass thresholds that scales with body size. Under K–Pg climatic forcings, the model reproduces successfully key observed extinction patterns, including the high vulnerability of planktic foraminifera and other zooplankton, the survival of small mixotrophs 4 and phytoplankton 5,6 , and potential for reduced diversity loss in high-latitude settings 7 . Our analysis suggests that impact-driven darkness and body-size-dependent extinction thresholds drove most of the observed extinction patterns. These results suggest that plankton ecologies enhance survival through differences in energy demand and acquisition. Our study bridges the gap between fossil evidence of extinction patterns and the K–Pg impact winter hypothesis, highlighting the value of trait-based models for understanding past biodiversity crises.
items.title_zh: 黑暗环境和体型大小影响了白垩纪末期海洋生物灭绝模式
items.abstract_zh: 希克苏鲁伯小行星撞击发生在白垩纪-古近纪（K-Pg）界线（距今6600万年），据信引发了灾难性的环境变化，导致化石记录中约75%的物种灭绝(1)。然而，尽管经过数十年的研究，环境变化与海洋化石记录中观察到的选择性灭绝模式之间的联系机制仍未得到阐明。本文利用一个基于性状的全球生态系统模型(2,3)，建立了除化石类群之外的海洋浮游生物群落的这种因果关系。我们的模型模拟了K-Pg界线后最初100年的物种多样性动态，并基于与体型成比例的生物量阈值，明确地表示了物种灭绝。在K-Pg气候强迫下，该模型成功地重现了观测到的关键灭绝模式，包括浮游有孔虫和其他浮游动物的高脆弱性、小型混合营养生物(4)和浮游植物(5,6)的存活，以及高纬度地区生物多样性丧失的可能性降低(7)。我们的分析表明，撞击导致的黑暗环境和体型依赖性的灭绝阈值是大多数观测到的灭绝模式的驱动因素。这些结果表明，浮游生物的生态特性通过能量需求和获取方式的差异来增强其存活率。我们的研究弥合了灭绝模式的化石证据与K-Pg撞击冬季假说之间的鸿沟，凸显了基于性状的模型在理解过去生物多样性危机方面的价值。

items.title: Widespread range contraction of carnivores in protected areas of China
items.publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
items.abstract: Protected areas (PAs) are cornerstones of biodiversity conservation, harbouring key mammal species such as apex predators that are important in maintaining trophic cascades and contribute to ecosystem resilience. However, whether PAs have preserved historical wildlife assemblages remains poorly quantified, mainly due to a lack of comparable data from historical and current periods. Here we used comprehensive data from historical investigations during the 1950s and 1970s, as well as current surveys based on 8,300 camera traps between 2008 and 2021 across 85 PAs in China, to assess range contractions of 82 large- and medium-bodied mammals. We found that carnivores disappeared from 59.4% of their historical sites, a rate much higher than that observed in ungulates (37.2%). Moreover, while 52.9% of PAs retained more than 70% of their ungulate species, over 70% of PAs lost over half of their carnivore species, with PAs in southern China being range contraction hotspots, particularly for carnivore species with larger body sizes and shorter generation lengths. Our findings reveal widespread range contraction of carnivores in China’s PAs compared with historical periods, driven primarily by legacy effects of large-scale anthropogenic disturbances and human–wildlife conflict, necessitating initiatives to maintain and restore historical assemblages of carnivores alongside habitat protection. Protected areas can be important in conserving key mammal species that help maintain ecosystem functioning. The authors examine how well protected areas achieve this, in the context of historical habitat loss and human–wildlife conflict, for 82 mammal species across China.
items.title_zh: 中国保护区内食肉动物活动范围普遍缩小

items.title: Gaps and drivers of global marine animal biodiversity from the surface to abyss
items.publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
items.abstract: With advances in global biodiversity data sharing, particularly following the Census of Marine Life, understanding of marine biodiversity has improved but remains incomplete. The Ocean Biodiversity Information System and Global Biodiversity Information Facility host over 150 million marine occurrence records, enabling reassessment of global biodiversity and data gaps. Here, we compile a quality-controlled dataset of ca. 48 million records covering 184,141 marine animal species, representing ~87% of accepted World Register of Marine Species and 91% of Ocean Biodiversity Information System taxa. Generalised Linear and Additive Models assess how geoecological drivers and human impact influence species richness while accounting for sampling effort and spatial autocorrelation across depth and taxa. Approximately 50% of the global ocean remains insufficiently sampled, with more than 160 million km² below 200 m lacking data. Sampling is biased toward developed regions, especially the North Atlantic, with major gaps in equatorial and Global South regions. Central tropical areas ( − 5° to 5°) contribute only <2.5% of global records, helping explain non-significant bimodal latitudinal patterns. Shallow-water richness is mainly associated with temperature, while deep-sea patterns relate to human impact (sampling intensity) and nitrate-driven remineralisation. These results highlight major global data gaps and the need for depth-explicit, bias-aware biodiversity assessment and monitoring to support conservation and the UN Ocean Decade.
items.title_zh: 从海面到深渊，全球海洋动物生物多样性的差距和驱动因素
items.abstract_zh: 希克苏鲁伯小行星撞击发生在白垩纪-古近纪（K-Pg）界线（距今6600万年），据信引发了灾难性的环境变化，导致化石记录中约75%的物种灭绝(1)。然而，尽管经过数十年的研究，环境变化与海洋化石记录中观察到的选择性灭绝模式之间的联系机制仍未得到阐明。本文利用一个基于性状的全球生态系统模型(2,3)，建立了除化石类群之外的海洋浮游生物群落的这种因果关系。我们的模型模拟了K-Pg界线后最初100年的物种多样性动态，并基于与体型成比例的生物量阈值，明确地表示了物种灭绝。在K-Pg气候强迫下，该模型成功地重现了观测到的关键灭绝模式，包括浮游有孔虫和其他浮游动物的高脆弱性、小型混合营养生物(4)和浮游植物(5,6)的存活，以及高纬度地区生物多样性丧失的可能性降低(7)。我们的分析表明，撞击导致的黑暗环境和体型依赖性的灭绝阈值是大多数观测到的灭绝模式的驱动因素。这些结果表明，浮游生物的生态特性通过能量需求和获取方式的差异来增强其存活率。我们的研究弥合了灭绝模式的化石证据与K-Pg撞击冬季假说之间的鸿沟，凸显了基于性状的模型在理解过去生物多样性危机方面的价值。

items.title: Mapping global resource driven nature loss in the mining sector from 2001 to 2022
items.publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
items.abstract: Global mineral extraction is expected to surge due to the growing demand for clean energy. While mining is critical to modern society, its environmental impacts, though increasingly studied, remain undocumented for half of the world's mining areas and are rarely analysed at the commodity level. Here, we introduce a novel approach integrating remote sensing, machine learning, and cloud computing to classify approximately 70,000 mining sites by commodity. Using this newly detailed dataset, we quantify the nature loss associated with 20 extracted commodities, focusing on deforestation and habitat destruction. From 2001 to 2022, mining activities worldwide resulted in the removal of 16,268 km² of forest cover, with 65.64% occurring in tropical and subtropical regions. Notably, approximately half of this deforestation was attributed to the extraction of gold, coal, aluminium (bauxite), nickel-cobalt and copper, primarily in countries intersecting the Amazon, Southeast Asian, and Congo Basin rainforests. Our analysis also reveals that deforestation-to-mining area ratios and biodiversity risks vary by mining location, and conservation threats do not always scale with deforestation rates. By providing commodity-specific maps of mining-induced nature loss, our work equips companies and organisations with actionable insights to identify risks within their supply chains and implement targeted mitigation strategies.
items.title_zh: 绘制2001年至2022年全球采矿业资源驱动型自然损失图
items.abstract_zh: 由于对清洁能源的需求不断增长，全球矿产开采预计将大幅增加。采矿业对现代社会至关重要，但其环境影响虽然日益受到关注，但仍有一半的矿区缺乏相关记录，且很少进行针对特定矿产的分析。本文介绍了一种结合遥感、机器学习和云计算的新方法，用于按矿产对约7万个矿区进行分类。利用这一新近完善的数据集，我们量化了20种矿产开采造成的自然损失，重点关注森林砍伐和栖息地破坏。2001年至2022年间，全球采矿活动导致16268平方公里森林面积消失，其中65.64%发生在热带和亚热带地区。值得注意的是，约一半的森林砍伐是由于黄金、煤炭、铝土矿、镍钴和铜的开采造成的，主要发生在亚马逊雨林、东南亚雨林和刚果盆地雨林交界的国家。我们的分析还表明，森林砍伐面积与采矿面积之比以及生物多样性风险因采矿地点而异，而且保护威胁并非总是与森林砍伐率成正比。通过提供针对特定商品的采矿引发的自然损失地图，我们的工作为企业和组织提供了可操作的见解，帮助他们识别供应链中的风险并实施有针对性的缓解策略。

items.title: Near-inertial internal waves funneled into Taylor caps shape seamount tops, with implications for biodiversity in the deep ocean
items.publisher: American Association for the Advancement of Science (AAAS)
items.abstract: Internal waves are energetic and ubiquitous in the ocean and their interactions with submarine topography could drive sediment resuspension and reshape seafloor substrate. However, the mechanisms governing these interactions are largely unknown. Here, using observational and reanalysis data at Pacific deep-sea seamounts, we show how near-inertial internal waves (NIWs) may affect substrate variability via interactions with seamounts. Taylor caps with anticyclonic vorticity generated above the seamounts can act as a “chimney” that focuses NIW energy. The NIWs can further undergo reflection at the summits and generate strong bottom currents to erode sediments. As wind energy input to NIWs increases with latitude, this process could contribute to the removal of sediments at seamount summits further north than 20°N, exposing the rock outcrops needed for biogenic structuring species and thus boosting species richness. Given that Taylor caps occur at ~93% of the global seamounts, our findings suggest a wave-topography interaction that could shape the substrate and enrich the biodiversity in the deep ocean.
items.title_zh: 近惯性内波汇聚到泰勒帽中，塑造了海山顶部的形状，这对深海生物多样性具有重要意义
items.abstract_zh: 内波能量充沛且在海洋中普遍存在，它们与海底地形的相互作用可驱动沉积物再悬浮并重塑海底基质。然而，控制这些相互作用的机制在很大程度上仍不清楚。本文利用太平洋深海海山的观测和再分析数据，揭示了近惯性内波（NIW）如何通过与海山的相互作用影响基质变化。海山上方产生的具有反气旋涡旋的泰勒帽可以起到“烟囱”的作用，集中NIW的能量。NIW在山顶会发生反射，并产生强烈的海底流，从而侵蚀沉积物。由于NIW的风能输入随纬度增加而增加，这一过程可能导致北纬20°以北海山山顶沉积物的移除，从而暴露出生物结构物种所需的岩石露头，进而提高物种丰富度。鉴于泰勒帽出现在全球93%的海山上，我们的研究结果表明波浪与地形的相互作用可以塑造海底基质，并丰富深海的生物多样性。

items.title: Landscape efficiency frontiers for biodiversity, climate mitigation, and net economic value
items.publisher: American Association for the Advancement of Science (AAAS)
items.abstract: National governments and multilateral institutions face difficult challenges reconciling biodiversity, climate, and economic development goals. We integrated spatial biophysical and economic data with optimization methods to develop sustainable landscape efficiency frontiers that show maximally feasible combinations of biodiversity conservation, land-based climate mitigation, and net economic value from agricultural crops, livestock, and forestry production. We applied this approach in 146 countries and found large potential gains in biodiversity, climate, and economic development from improved land use and land management. Summing national-level results shows the potential to increase climate mitigation by more than 200 billion metric tons of CO 2 equivalents (>20% increase) or net economic value by more than US$350 billion (>80% increase), without loss in other objectives.
items.title_zh: 景观效率前沿：生物多样性、气候减缓和净经济价值
items.abstract_zh: 各国政府和多边机构在协调生物多样性、气候和经济发展目标方面面临着严峻挑战。我们整合了空间生物物理和经济数据以及优化方法，构建了可持续景观效率前沿，展示了生物多样性保护、基于土地的气候减缓以及农作物、畜牧业和林业生产带来的净经济价值的最佳可行组合。我们将此方法应用于146个国家，发现通过改善土地利用和土地管理，可以在生物多样性、气候和经济发展方面获得巨大的潜在收益。汇总各国的结果显示，在不影响其他目标的前提下，气候减缓潜力可增加超过2000亿吨二氧化碳当量（增幅超过20%），或净经济价值增加超过3500亿美元（增幅超过80%）。

items.title: Climate and regional plant richness drive diet specialization in butterfly caterpillars
items.publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
items.abstract: Studies of coevolution, ecosystem processes, and latitudinal diversity gradients are improved by understanding variation in resource specialization. Insect herbivory is one of the most ubiquitous terrestrial ecological associations that drives the evolution of plants and insects. However, a broad understanding of how and why herbivore diet specificity varies worldwide is lacking. Here, we use global datasets of butterfly and plant distributions to investigate patterns and drivers of butterfly larval diet breadth. Hostplant richness and phylogenetic diversity showed non-monotonic latitudinal patterns that narrowed near the equator and temperate latitudes and broadened at mid-tropical latitudes and the poles. Diet breadth showed a negative relationship with plant family richness, but we also uncovered an interaction between precipitation seasonality and temperature. Our study builds on 60 years of study of butterfly-hostplant evolution to provide valuable insights into how these processes continue to shape plant and herbivore dynamics in response to global environmental changes.
items.title_zh: 气候和区域植物丰富度决定了蝴蝶幼虫的食性专一性
items.abstract_zh: 通过了解资源特化程度的差异，可以更好地研究协同进化、生态系统过程和纬度多样性梯度。昆虫取食是陆地生态中最普遍的关联之一，对于理解植物和昆虫的进化都至关重要，然而，全球食性广度差异背后的机制仍然知之甚少。本文利用蝴蝶和植物分布的全球数据集，研究了蝴蝶幼虫食性广度的模式和驱动因素。研究发现，食性广度与植物科级丰富度呈负相关，但温度的反向直接影响抵消了这种负相关关系。岛屿上的物种通常食性更广，但特有种比例较高的岛屿的物种食性却比平均水平更窄。我们的研究为理解在全球环境变化背景下植物和植食动物的相互作用如何构建生态群落提供了全球基线。

items.title: Ninety-year trends reveal sharpest insect declines in the mid-twentieth century
items.publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
items.abstract: Most studies on insect trends have focused on the past few decades, but major changes could have occurred earlier. If so, shifted baselines can result in misleading conclusions or poor conservation decisions. Here we analyse nine decades of insect trends in Switzerland and relate them to changes in land use and climate. By reconstructing continuous trends in species richness based on 1.2 million records of 595 saproxylic beetle and 216 butterfly species, we find that both groups declined from the 1930s to the 1960s. While saproxylic beetle richness stabilized and subsequently recovered, butterfly richness continued to decline until the 1980s and has not recovered. The strong mid-century decreases were linked to increases in agricultural mechanization, while the subsequent increases were linked to climate warming. Over the entire 90-year period, declines primarily affected specialist and cold-adapted species, while warm-adapted species have increased since the 1980s. Recent gains in saproxylic beetle richness might also reflect increased deadwood availability from windthrow and ‘biodiversity-friendly’ forest management. Our findings suggest that reducing adverse land use is key to maintaining and promoting insect diversity, and that shifted baselines and climate-change effects should be considered when setting restoration goals and priorities.
items.title_zh: 九十年的趋势表明，昆虫数量在二十世纪中期下降最为显著
items.abstract_zh: 大多数关于昆虫趋势的研究都集中在过去几十年，但重大变化可能更早发生。如果真是如此，基线偏移可能会导致误导性的结论或错误的保护决策。本文分析了瑞士九十年的昆虫趋势，并将其与土地利用和气候变化联系起来。我们基于595种腐木甲虫和216种蝴蝶的120万条记录，重建了物种丰富度的连续趋势，发现这两个类群的物种丰富度均从20世纪30年代到60年代呈下降趋势。腐木甲虫的物种丰富度趋于稳定并随后有所恢复，而蝴蝶的物种丰富度则持续下降至20世纪80年代，至今仍未恢复。20世纪中期的急剧下降与农业机械化程度的提高有关，而随后的上升则与气候变暖有关。在整个90年期间，物种丰富度的下降主要影响的是适应性强、耐寒的物种，而自20世纪80年代以来，适应温暖环境的物种数量有所增加。腐木甲虫物种丰富度的近期增长也可能反映了风倒木和“生物多样性友好型”森林管理措施带来的枯木供应增加。我们的研究结果表明，减少不利的土地利用是维持和促进昆虫多样性的关键，并且在制定恢复目标和优先事项时，应考虑基线变化和气候变化的影响。

items.title: Bird migration and wind-energy production across Western Europe
items.publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
items.abstract: With global ambitions to decarbonize the energy system, wind power capacity will continue to increase dramatically worldwide. This raises concerns about environmental impacts of wind energy infrastructure and operations, particularly for collision of aerial wildlife. Using a network of weather surveillance radars, we quantified numbers, timing and spatial extent of nightly and annual large-scale bird movements over Western Europe. We also mapped onshore wind turbines and calculated potential energy production using wind speed and distribution data. Integrating bird movement patterns, turbine characteristics and energy production, we estimated the number of birds that are potentially at risk of collision because they fly in proximity to wind turbines and at heights of rotating blades. To demonstrate potential for designing measures to mitigate risk to aerial biodiversity, we derive curtailment scenarios and compare costs and benefits for energy production and conserving biodiversity and show that surprisingly efficient trade-offs may be possible. Our findings contribute to broader efforts for minimizing impacts from wind energy production on migratory bird populations while endeavouring to ensure adequate energy supply.
items.title_zh: 西欧的鸟类迁徙和风能生产
items.abstract_zh: 随着全球能源系统脱碳目标的实现，风电装机容量将在全球范围内持续大幅增长。这引发了人们对风能基础设施和运营对环境影响的担忧，尤其是对空中野生动物碰撞的风险。我们利用气象雷达网络，量化了西欧地区夜间和年度大规模鸟类迁徙的数量、时间和空间范围。我们还绘制了陆上风力涡轮机的分布图，并利用风速和风力分布数据计算了潜在的发电量。通过整合鸟类迁徙模式、涡轮机特性和发电量，我们估算了因飞行于风力涡轮机附近以及旋转叶片高度而面临碰撞风险的鸟类数量。为了展示设计措施以降低对空中生物多样性风险的潜力，我们构建了限电方案，并比较了能源生产和生物多样性保护的成本和效益，结果表明，可能存在出人意料的高效权衡方案。我们的研究结果有助于更广泛地减少风能生产对候鸟种群的影响，同时努力确保充足的能源供应。

items.title: Comparing potential biodiversity conflicts from renewable energy expansion in China at different centralization levels
items.publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
items.abstract: The rapid deployment of renewable energy creates urgent trade-offs with biodiversity conservation. The uneven distribution of renewable energy potential and biodiversity creates a critical governance challenge: at which administrative level should goal setting and spatial planning decisions be set to best mitigate these conflicts? Here we model the expansion of solar and wind energy in China through 2060 to reach its carbon neutrality goal, to compare a centralized national planning scenario against the current provincial (more decentralized) planning approach. We find that national sitings’ spatial conflict with richness-based conservation priorities is 4–7% less and overlaps 11–33% fewer species on average than the provincial planning. However, these gains are offset by greater conflicts with functional diversity and with open or dry biomes, including associated species such as the endangered marbled polecat (Vormela peregusna). By contrast, decentralized planning disproportionately overlapped more with the habitats of small-ranged forest species. Such divergence reveals the limitations of any single governance level in addressing these trade-offs, showing the imperative for integrated, multilevel siting frameworks. Effectively meeting dual climate and biodiversity targets requires strategies that synthesize strengths across administrative scales. Modelling of wind and solar energy expansion in China through to 2060 identifies different conflicts between conservation priorities and renewables sitings under national (centralized) versus provincial-level planning approaches.
items.title_zh: 比较中国不同集中化程度下可再生能源扩张可能引发的生物多样性冲突

items.title: Mining triggers extensive additional deforestation in sub-Saharan Africa
items.publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
items.abstract: Demand for minerals sourced from sub-Saharan Africa is expanding rapidly 1–5 . If poorly managed, mining expansion poses a key threat to tropical forests across the continent 6,7 . Here we present a spatiotemporal assessment of mining-driven deforestation of dense forests across Africa, using continent-wide data on post-deforestation land uses and a robust difference-in-differences framework to assess 16,627 mines between 2001 and 2020. In total, we find 187,000 hectares of direct mining-driven deforestation, that is, deforestation due to features directly associated with mining operations, such as pits, tailing ponds and spoil heaps. We estimate that mining also triggers an additional 8.0 percentage points (pp; 95% confidence interval (CI): 7.2–8.9 pp) increase in deforestation within 1 km of a mine compared with unmined areas. Increased levels of deforestation (1.1 pp, 95% CI: 0.7–1.5) persist up to 20 km from mines even after ten years. For every hectare of direct deforestation due to the mine footprint, mining triggers, on average, 34 hectares of additional offsite loss within five years through ancillary activities, including agriculture and settlements. Mines extracting cobalt and copper—key energy transition minerals—caused the highest amount of additional deforestation. Embedding offsite deforestation levels into environmental impact assessments for new mining projects will be key to ensuring zero-deforestation or no-net-loss supply chains for critical minerals and reduce future mining-driven forest losses in sub-Saharan Africa.
items.title_zh: 采矿活动导致撒哈拉以南非洲地区出现大面积森林砍伐
items.abstract_zh: 对撒哈拉以南非洲矿产的需求正在迅速增长。如果管理不善，采矿扩张将对整个非洲大陆的热带森林构成重大威胁。本文利用非洲大陆范围内的森林砍伐后土地利用数据，并采用稳健的双重差分法，对2001年至2020年间16,627个矿场进行了时空评估，以分析采矿活动导致的非洲茂密森林砍伐情况。结果显示，共有187,000公顷的森林直接由采矿活动导致砍伐，即由与采矿作业直接相关的特征（如矿坑、尾矿池和废石堆）造成的森林砍伐。我们估计，与未开采区域相比，采矿活动还会导致矿场周围1公里范围内的森林砍伐率额外增加8.0个百分点（95%置信区间：7.2-8.9个百分点）。即使在矿区开采十年后，矿区周围20公里范围内的森林砍伐率仍然持续上升（上升1.1个百分点，95%置信区间：0.7-1.5）。矿区本身造成的每公顷直接森林砍伐，平均会在五年内通过农业和居民区等辅助活动引发34公顷额外的场外森林损失。开采钴和铜（关键能源转型矿物）的矿山造成的额外森林砍伐量最大。将场外森林砍伐量纳入新采矿项目的环境影响评估，对于确保关键矿物供应链的零森林砍伐或净零损失，以及减少撒哈拉以南非洲未来采矿活动造成的森林损失至关重要。

items.title: Biodiversity loss will decrease the future creditworthiness of nations
items.publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
items.abstract: Biodiversity loss and deforestation are increasingly recognized as systemic economic risks. Yet, their implications for financial markets remain poorly understood. Here we study how biodiversity and ecosystem service loss affect financial risk for the world’s largest asset class, sovereign debt. Environmental degradation undermines the natural foundations of economic activity, reducing productive capacity and the ability of governments to service debt. Currently, sovereign credit ratings ignore these risks, meaning that markets may be mispricing, mismanaging and misallocating US$83 trillion of financial assets. We incorporate biodiversity risk into sovereign credit assessments by extending S&P Global’s methodology to include scenarios for future tropical timber, wild pollination and marine fisheries services across 23 countries, representing 5.5 billion people. A partial ecosystem collapse scenario increases annual debt servicing costs by US$49 billion in India, equivalent to 2.4% of median post-tax income, and by US$70 billion in China. Across countries, additional annual interest payments could reach US$162 billion, nearly reaching the US$200 billion per year target for conservation support under the Global Biodiversity Framework. Angola, Bangladesh, the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Madagascar could face gross domestic product losses of more than 15% by 2030. Our results suggest that financial markets are systematically underpricing nature-related risks, with consequences for public finances, nature and financial stability.
items.title_zh: 生物多样性丧失将降低国家未来的信用评级
items.abstract_zh: 生物多样性丧失和森林砍伐日益被认为是系统性经济风险。然而，它们对金融市场的影响仍然知之甚少。本文研究了生物多样性和生态系统服务丧失如何影响全球最大资产类别——主权债务的金融风险。环境恶化破坏了经济活动的自然基础，降低了生产能力和政府偿债能力。目前，主权信用评级忽略了这些风险，这意味着市场可能对价值83万亿美元的金融资产进行了定价错误、管理不善和配置不当。我们通过扩展标普全球的方法，将生物多样性风险纳入主权信用评估，纳入了23个国家（代表55亿人口）未来热带木材、野生授粉和海洋渔业服务的情景。部分生态系统崩溃情景将使印度的年度偿债成本增加490亿美元，相当于税后收入中位数的2.4%；在中国，这一数字将增加700亿美元。各国每年新增利息支出可能高达1620亿美元，几乎达到《全球生物多样性框架》设定的每年2000亿美元的保护支持目标。到2030年，安哥拉、孟加拉国、刚果民主共和国和马达加斯加的国内生产总值可能损失超过15%。我们的研究结果表明，金融市场系统性地低估了与自然相关的风险，这将对公共财政、自然环境和金融稳定产生影响。

items.title: A global early warning system for predicting exposure of biodiversity to extreme heat
items.publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
items.abstract: Effective biodiversity conservation during periods of rapid environmental change requires identifying the species and regions at greatest risk. However, most predictions focus on biodiversity shifts several decades ahead, offering limited guidance for immediate conservation action. Here we develop an early warning system for biodiversity based on 9-month seasonal weather forecasts combined with species-specific historical temperature limits. In May 2024, we predicted that >3,500 vertebrate species (out of 30,585 species), including >1,250 species of conservation concern, would be substantially exposed to extreme temperatures 1–2 months in advance on average. Mexico, Sub-Saharan Africa and the Himalayas were predicted to face the highest threats during this forecast period. Early evidence suggests that exposure in these regions likely negatively impacted some species populations. Such advance notice can enable rapid actions to monitor and mitigate these extreme events for sensitive species and regions. The authors develop an early warning system to predict the risks of extreme temperatures for 30,585 vertebrates 1–9 months in advance. They identify species and regions at risk and highlight the potential for early warning systems to maximize management activities that mitigate negative outcomes.
items.title_zh: 一个用于预测生物多样性暴露于极端高温的全球预警系统

items.title: Amplified Arctic iceberg traffic reshapes benthic biodiversity
items.publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
items.abstract: The Arctic is undergoing rapid warming, resulting in retreating sea ice and glaciers 1 , yet how cryospheric changes propagate into the deep ocean remains poorly understood 2 . Here we identify a climate-driven mechanism linking accelerating glacier disintegration to an increase in deep-sea hard-bottom habitats far beyond calving fronts. Seafloor observations in Fram Strait show a localized increase in the density and patchiness of dropstones delivered by debris-laden icebergs. At the same time, four decades of shipboard records show that the occurrence of icebergs increased abruptly in the early 2000s. Backtracking links these icebergs to the main outlet glaciers in northeast Greenland and the Russian High Arctic. In northeast Greenland, the timing of glacier destabilization coincides with this rise, whereas sparse satellite coverage in the Russian sector limits temporal attribution despite indications of enhanced glacier activity. A model sensitivity study shows that, apart from intensified calving, a more dynamic sea ice cover enhances downstream transport of glacial ice. Along these pathways, increased iceberg activity could reshape deep-sea habitats through enhanced melt and associated lithogenic input, and elevate navigational hazards as maritime traffic expands in the Arctic. Although modest compared with the iceberg discharges of Pleistocene Heinrich events, this mechanism provides a modern analogue of long-range cryospheric influence on the seafloor in a warming climate.
items.title_zh: 北极冰山交通量的增加重塑了底栖生物多样性系统
items.abstract_zh: 北极正在经历快速变暖，导致海冰和冰川消退，然而冰冻圈的变化如何传播到深海仍然知之甚少。本文揭示了一种气候驱动机制，该机制将加速的冰川崩解与远超冰川崩解锋面的深海硬底栖息地的增加联系起来。弗拉姆海峡的海底观测显示，由携带碎屑的冰山带来的漂砾的密度和分布不均在局部地区有所增加。与此同时，四十年的船载记录表明，冰山的出现频率在21世纪初急剧上升。回溯分析将这些冰山与格陵兰岛东北部和俄罗斯高北极地区的主要出口冰川联系起来。在格陵兰岛东北部，冰川不稳定的时间与冰山数量的增加相吻合，而俄罗斯海域卫星覆盖稀疏，尽管有迹象表明冰川活动增强，但仍难以确定其发生的时间。模型敏感性研究表明，除了冰崩加剧外，更具动态性的海冰覆盖还会增强冰川冰向下游的输送。沿着这些路径，冰山活动的增加可能会通过加剧融化和相关的岩屑输入来重塑深海栖息地，并随着北极海上交通的扩张而加剧航行危险。尽管与更新世海因里希事件的冰山倾泻量相比微不足道，但这种机制为气候变暖背景下冰冻圈对海底的长距离影响提供了一个现代类比。

items.title: Decadal-scale pollen records link land use and plant diversity change across European lowlands over seven millennia
items.publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
items.abstract: Understanding the long-term drivers of biodiversity change requires datasets that expand the timescale of ecological observations. Using lake sediments as natural archives, we reconstruct plant diversity change at high temporal resolution across the Swiss Plateau, a key region for European land use history. Contiguous pollen records, from three sites, spanning 7.6 millennia, were constrained by 227 radiocarbon dates and partly annually laminated sequences, yielding decadal-scale chronologies. We examine relationships between palynological richness (PRI), a proxy for plant diversity, and reconstructed land use probability (LUP) across six cultural-historic epochs. Vegetation histories are similar across sites: while beech forests persist throughout, other deciduous trees decline and grassland taxa expand from the Neolithic onwards. Plant diversity responds strongly to land use, increasing with openings, cultivation and fire, and declining during crises such as the Migration Period and the Black Death. Medieval and early modern landscapes support the highest richness, while diversity has declined in recent decades, likely due to industrialised agriculture. Our findings show that humans have been major drivers of plant diversity change in European lowlands for more than seven millennia and that sustainable land use legacies from the past may hold the key to reversing today's biodiversity losses.
items.title_zh: 数十年尺度的花粉记录将七千年来欧洲低地的土地利用和植物多样性变化联系起来
items.abstract_zh: 要了解生物多样性变化的长期驱动因素，需要扩展生态观测时间尺度的数据集。我们利用湖泊沉积物作为天然档案，以高时间分辨率重建了瑞士高原（欧洲土地利用历史的关键区域）的植物多样性变化。来自三个地点的连续花粉记录跨越7600年，并结合227个放射性碳测年数据和部分年层理序列进行约束，从而构建了十年尺度的年代序列。我们研究了六个文化历史时期中，花粉丰富度（PRI，植物多样性的指标）与重建的土地利用概率（LUP）之间的关系。各地点的植被历史相似：山毛榉林贯穿始终，而其他落叶树种则从新石器时代开始减少，草地物种则逐渐扩张。植物多样性对土地利用方式的响应强烈，随着土地开垦、耕作和火灾的发生而增加，并在诸如民族大迁徙时期和黑死病等危机期间下降。中世纪和近代早期的景观孕育了最丰富的物种，但近几十年来，物种多样性有所下降，这很可能是由于工业化农业造成的。我们的研究结果表明，七千多年来，人类一直是欧洲低地植物多样性变化的主要驱动因素，而过去可持续的土地利用方式或许是扭转当今生物多样性丧失的关键。

items.title: Crop fields complement biodiversity in permanent grasslands across European landscapes
items.publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
items.abstract: Temperate agricultural landscapes are experiencing unprecedented biodiversity declines. Landscape simplification is commonly identified as a driver of species loss across taxonomic groups, but the contribution of crop and non-crop habitats to farmland biodiversity conservation is surprisingly poorly known. Using 86 paired permanent grasslands and oilseed rape fields in five European countries, we assess how habitat type shaped plant, butterfly, wild bee, and carabid assemblages and whether increasing grassland amount in surrounding landscapes fosters the spillover of grassland-associated biodiversity to oilseed rape fields. We find habitat type rather than landscape-level grassland amount determines diversity and shapes species assemblages: plants and butterflies are more diverse in grasslands, while wild bees and carabids are equally or more diverse in oilseed rape fields. Increasing landscape-level grassland amount affects species assemblage composition but only reduces turnover between habitats in wild bees. Overall, both grasslands and oilseed rape fields harbour distinct sets of species, together contributing complementarily to regional diversity. Safeguarding biodiversity in agricultural landscapes therefore requires not only the conservation of permanent semi-natural habitats but also biodiversity-friendly management of disturbed habitats such as crop fields that can contribute valuable species.
items.title_zh: 农田与欧洲各地的永久性草地形成互补，共同维护着生物多样性
items.abstract_zh: 温带农业景观正经历前所未有的生物多样性下降。景观简化通常被认为是导致不同分类群物种丧失的驱动因素，但作物和非作物生境对农田生物多样性保护的贡献却鲜为人知。我们选取欧洲五个国家的86对永久性草地和油菜田作为研究对象，评估了生境类型如何影响植物、蝴蝶、野生蜜蜂和步甲的群落组成，以及增加周边景观中的草地面积是否能促进草地相关生物多样性向油菜田的溢出效应。研究发现，决定生物多样性和物种群落组成的是生境类型而非景观层面的草地面积：植物和蝴蝶在草地中更为多样化，而野生蜜蜂和步甲在油菜田中的多样性与草地相当或更高。增加景观层面的草地面积会影响物种群落组成，但只会降低野生蜜蜂在不同生境间的物种更替率。总体而言，草地和油菜田都孕育着不同的物种群落，二者相互补充，共同促进了区域生物多样性。因此，保护农业景观中的生物多样性不仅需要保护永久性的半自然栖息地，还需要对受干扰的栖息地（如农田）进行有利于生物多样性的管理，因为农田可以为这些栖息地提供有价值的物种。

items.title: The effects of plastic pollution on biodiversity
items.publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
items.abstract: As plastic is increasingly found in natural environments, concern has grown about its biological effects beyond individual-level impacts, particularly on species health, food-web dynamics and ecosystem functioning. In this Review, we summarize current evidence on plastic exposure pathways, organismal responses and potential effects at higher levels of biological organization. Impacts on individual organisms can be acute or chronic, and include physiological stress, disrupted locomotion, feeding and reproduction, internal injury, and death. Sublethal effects might not be immediately detectable but can have profound implications for individual fitness. Although macroplastics can cause mortality, their role in population declines remains largely uncertain, and demonstrated impacts beyond the individual level are rare. Clear evidence of population-level harm from microplastics to wild organisms is lacking. Nevertheless, emerging research demonstrates a growing likelihood of broader effects, particularly for species with high plastic-encounter rates. Connecting environmental exposure to individual-level fitness and population-level consequences is a critical frontier. Future research must prioritize long-term monitoring, demographic modelling and high-throughput methods to accurately quantify risks to biodiversity. Effective solutions must be context-specific, span local to global scales, account for interactions with other stressors and integrate plastic pollution mitigation policies with broader conservation strategies to safeguard biodiversity in the Anthropocene. Plastic pollution is pervasive across ecosystems, but its impacts on biodiversity remain poorly understood. This Review assesses current understanding of exposure and biological effects, evaluating the evidence for broader biodiversity impacts and outlining priorities for research, monitoring and mitigation.
items.title_zh: 塑料污染对生物多样性的影响

items.title: Compound climate events threaten tropical semi-enclosed marine ecosystems
items.publisher: American Association for the Advancement of Science (AAAS)
items.abstract: Anthropogenic ocean warming affects ecosystem functioning but is not necessarily the primary climate driver regulating tropical seas. Tropical semi-enclosed marine ecosystems are poorly understood, geographically distinct, and influenced by compounding impacts from global warming, cyclones, monsoons, freshwater influx, and massive sea-level and circulation variability. We unify climate risk understanding of these large-scale integrated ocean-atmosphere-biological systems, showing that compound climate events expose resident species to larger, prolonged fluctuations, causing reconfigured spatial patterns and lack of sustained hydrological connectivity. We attribute changes in species’ abundance in these systems to complex and cumulative combinations of extreme temperatures, exposure, turbidity, and hydrologic connections. We describe evidence of such climate-induced physical and biological regime shifts in tropical marine ecosystems in northern Australia and identify implications for other systems.
items.title_zh: 复合型气候事件威胁热带半封闭海洋生态系统
items.abstract_zh: 人为造成的海洋变暖影响生态系统功能，但并非热带海洋的主要气候驱动因素。热带半封闭海洋生态系统的了解甚少，其地理分布独特，并受到全球变暖、气旋、季风、淡水输入以及海平面和环流剧烈变化等多种因素的叠加影响。我们整合了对这些大规模海洋-大气-生物综合系统的气候风险认知，表明复合气候事件会使本地物种面临更大、更持久的波动，导致空间格局重塑和水文连通性丧失。我们将这些系统中物种丰度的变化归因于极端温度、暴露程度、浊度和水文连通性等因素的复杂累积组合。我们描述了澳大利亚北部热带海洋生态系统中此类气候诱发的物理和生物状态转变的证据，并探讨了其对其他系统的启示。

items.title: Diversity patterns are parsimoniously explained by equilibrium dynamics
items.publisher: Elsevier BV
items.title_zh: 多样性模式可以用平衡动力学来简洁地解释

items.title: Landscape quality drives ecological responses to habitat loss and fragmentation
items.publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
items.abstract: Studies have suggested that the quality of the lands surrounding habitat patches can modify the effects of habitat loss and fragmentation on species and influence biodiversity predictions across regions. As landscape matrices tend to be complex and vary with habitat change, isolating such effects is challenging. Here we disentangle the effects of habitat loss, fragmentation and surrounding landscape quality in a large, multiscale manipulative experiment on a plant–herbivore system. We find that habitat loss, fragmentation and surrounding matrix quality all affect survival rates, with the greatest negative effects of fragmentation and lower matrix quality under high habitat loss. Demographic rate changes resulted in strong negative effects of habitat loss, fragmentation and low matrix quality on population size at the landscape scale. Our findings indicate that the benefits of high landscape quality are greater in landscapes with low habitat fragmentation, contesting the common expectation that the surrounding matrix matters only in the most fragmented landscapes. This underscores that the quality of the surrounding landscape can have outsized effects on biodiversity in remaining habitats.
items.title_zh: 景观质量驱动着生态系统对栖息地丧失和破碎化的响应
items.abstract_zh: 研究表明，栖息地斑块周围土地的质量会影响栖息地丧失和破碎化对物种的影响，并影响区域生物多样性预测。由于景观基质往往复杂且随栖息地变化而变化，因此分离这些影响具有挑战性。本文通过一项针对植物-食草动物系统的大型多尺度操控实验，分离了栖息地丧失、破碎化和周围景观质量的影响。我们发现，栖息地丧失、破碎化和周围基质质量均会影响存活率，其中在栖息地丧失严重的情况下，破碎化和较低的基质质量会产生最大的负面影响。人口统计速率的变化导致栖息地丧失、破碎化和较低的基质质量对景观尺度上的种群数量产生显著的负面影响。我们的研究结果表明，在栖息地破碎化程度较低的景观中，高景观质量带来的益处更大，这与通常认为周围基质仅在破碎化程度最高的景观中才起作用的观点相悖。这强调了周围景观质量对剩余栖息地生物多样性的影响可能非常显著。

items.title: Temperate local extinctions from climate change are outpacing tropical extinctions
items.publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
items.abstract: Climate change may soon cause a catastrophic loss of global biodiversity. For decades, tropical species have widely been considered more vulnerable than temperate species. However, some studies have suggested the opposite. Using a global-scale dataset from resurvey studies spanning 5,151 plant and animal species encompassing 39,157 sites, we show that climate-related local extinctions were significantly more frequent among temperate (49% of surveyed species) than tropical species (33%). We then tested whether these more frequent temperate extinctions were explained by greater sensitivity to warming among temperate species, by faster warming at higher latitudes, or both. We found that extinction probabilities increased significantly with the magnitude of recent warming in temperate regions, and that temperate species also showed a general trend towards higher sensitivity to warming. Overall, our findings challenge the long-held view that climate change more strongly impacts tropical species and suggest that temperate species are increasingly vulnerable. The authors analyse global-scale resurvey data for 5,151 species to reveal the sensitivity of tropical versus temperate species to climate change. They show significantly higher frequencies of local extinction in temperate species than in tropical species, linked to faster warming at high latitudes.
items.title_zh: 气候变化导致的温带地区局部物种灭绝速度超过了热带地区

items.title: Oil crop supply chains drive rising global biodiversity loss and outsource impacts to the tropics
items.publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
items.abstract: Oil crop expansion threatens global biodiversity, yet its supply chain impacts remain poorly quantified. Here we analyse biodiversity impacts along oil crop supply chains from 1995 to 2020 using spatially explicit assessments, a hybridized multi-regional input–output framework, enhanced supply chain mapping and structural decomposition analysis. By 2020, oil crop cultivation caused the potential long-term loss of 1.5% of global species (plants and terrestrial vertebrates), with oil palm, coconuts and soybeans responsible for three-quarters of this effect. Tropical regions, occupying just under half of harvested area, bear almost four-fifths of impacts. More than half of this loss was outsourced through international trade, as major importers displace biodiversity burdens to tropical regions. Biodiversity impacts increased by four-fifths since 1995, statistically attributed primarily to rising per capita consumption. Our findings identify production hotspots and consumption-side contributions, supporting targeted interventions to mitigate biodiversity impacts along oil crop supply chains. Spatial assessments reveal that oil crop expansion, particularly in tropical regions, threaten global biodiversity. Hotspots of production and consumption are identified, showing that consumption-side interventions can aid in developing strategies to reduce biodiversity impacts.
items.title_zh: 油料作物供应链加剧了全球生物多样性丧失，并将影响转移到热带地区

items.title: A call to integrate animal movement into biodiversity indicators
items.publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
items.abstract: Animal movement data have transformed our understanding of ecological systems and shaped conservation practice, but have limited influence on tracking progress towards international biodiversity goals. Existing biodiversity indicators adopted in frameworks such as the Kunming–Montréal Global Biodiversity Framework — the primary multilateral conservation agreement that aims to halt and reverse biodiversity loss by 2030 — are typically not responsive enough to detect biodiversity change in time to guide action, nor sufficiently biologically informative to explain or predict changes.
