In this Perspective, we provide seven reasons why movement data can help to tackle these limitations by adding biological realism, mechanistic understanding, and early-warning capacity to current and future indicators. Movement data already inform conservation efforts, from local management to global treaties for migratory species, and are increasingly helpful to uncover sources of environmental change, while enhancing monitoring capability and policy relevance. We recommend that the scientific community ground existing connectivity metrics in empirical movement data, develop new indicators that flag rapid change, and invest in modelling and attribution studies that use movement data to identify drivers of biodiversity loss and recovery. Biodiversity indicators are essential for tracking progress towards international biodiversity goals, but existing indicators have important shortcomings and are not based on animal movement data. This Perspective outlines why incorporating movement data into biodiversity indicators can help to address these shortcomings, improve monitoring and inform effective conservation actions.
items.title_zh: 呼吁将动物迁徙纳入生物多样性指标

items.title: Global impacts of drifting fish aggregating devices on marine protected areas
items.publisher: American Association for the Advancement of Science (AAAS)
items.abstract: Protected areas are a critical component of efforts to reverse biodiversity loss by 2050. In the ocean, free-drifting fish aggregating devices (dFADs) are released in large numbers by industrial purse seine fishing companies to help catch tuna. These devices can enter marine protected areas (MPAs) undetected, potentially leading to wildlife entanglement, plastic pollution, and habitat degradation. Here we investigate processes by which dFADs may compromise MPA objectives and assess the burden they put on existing MPAs. By analyzing drift, strandings, and expert interview data, we show that dFADs have likely interacted with 53% of the global MPA network by area and stranded in 174 protected areas, which are home to at least 490 at-risk species. While recent improvements to dFAD design should reduce harm to wildlife, our findings suggest that improved regulation, transparency, and industry accountability are required to mitigate additional effects on MPAs, especially around documented hotspots in the central Pacific, western Indian Ocean, and Caribbean.
items.title_zh: 漂流式集鱼装置对海洋保护区的全球影响
items.abstract_zh: 保护区是到2050年扭转生物多样性丧失趋势的关键组成部分。在海洋中，工业围网捕捞公司大量投放自由漂流式集鱼装置（dFADs）以辅助金枪鱼捕捞。这些装置可能在未被察觉的情况下进入海洋保护区（MPAs），从而导致野生动物缠绕、塑料污染和栖息地退化。本文研究了dFADs可能损害海洋保护区目标的途径，并评估了它们对现有海洋保护区造成的负担。通过分析漂流、搁浅和专家访谈数据，我们发现dFADs可能已与全球53%的海洋保护区网络发生相互作用，并在174个保护区搁浅，这些保护区至少栖息着490种濒危物种。虽然dFADs设计的最新改进应能减少对野生动物的伤害，但我们的研究结果表明，需要加强监管、提高透明度并强化行业问责制，以减轻dFADs对海洋保护区的进一步影响，尤其是在中太平洋、西印度洋和加勒比海等已记录的热点区域附近。

items.title: Changes in wildlife activity patterns in response to war in Ukraine
items.publisher: American Association for the Advancement of Science (AAAS)
items.abstract: Conflict zones are inherently hazardous and inaccessible for researchers, which results in a knowledge gap about the immediate effects of armed conflicts on the environment, particularly wildlife. We used camera-trap detections to investigate the impact of armed conflict on wildlife activity patterns before, during, and after the Russian occupation of the Chornobyl Exclusion Zone (Ukraine) in 2022 and compared it to the same period in 2021. Mammal species responded to armed conflict through immediate behavioral adjustments, including reduced activity during night and on dates when armed-conflict activities intensified. Our results provide insight into wildlife’s behavioral responses to armed conflict in real time and underscore the potential of camera trapping to quantify the ecological effects of war.
items.title_zh: 乌克兰战争对野生动物活动模式的影响
items.abstract_zh: 冲突地区本身就充满危险，且研究人员难以进入，这导致人们对武装冲突对环境（尤其是野生动物）的直接影响知之甚少。我们利用红外相机监测数据，研究了2022年俄罗斯占领切尔诺贝利禁区（乌克兰）前后，武装冲突对野生动物活动模式的影响，并与2021年同期进行了比较。哺乳动物通过行为上的即时调整来应对武装冲突，包括减少夜间活动以及在武装冲突加剧的日期进行活动。我们的研究结果揭示了野生动物对武装冲突的实时行为反应，并强调了红外相机监测在量化战争生态影响方面的潜力。

items.title: Joint compliance with food security and environmental constraints limits the global potential of energy crops
items.publisher: Elsevier BV
items.title_zh: 粮食安全和环境限制因素共同制约了能源作物的全球潜力

items.title: Ecological integrity of avoided deforestation projects
items.publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
items.abstract: Reducing deforestation is proposed as a global climate action, yet it remains unclear whether carbon projects based on such interventions also maintain forests’ ecological conditions. Here we evaluate 133 projects against matched controls using five ecological-integrity indicators, to show that most projects have mixed, negligible or negative impacts relative to control areas. Results highlight fundamental shortcomings of these climate solutions that limit their ability to safeguard healthy ecosystems and sequester carbon. The authors assess 133 avoided deforestation projects for their ability to safeguard forest ecological integrity. While some projects maintain integrity, most show variable outcomes, with mixed, negligible or negative effects relative to matched controls.
items.title_zh: 减少森林砍伐项目的生态完整性

items.title: Linking species local trends from assemblage monitoring to global extinction risk
items.publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
items.abstract: While biodiversity is being reshaped across the globe, extinction risk assessments are lacking for most species, and a major challenge remains in understanding whether global threat status aligns with local population trends. Here, we assess whether population temporal prevalence trends are consistent with a species’ global extinction risk, using over 60,000 populations of 2362 species across 978 marine and terrestrial assemblages (sampled for at least 20 years, mostly from temperate regions). We assign each population to one of five categories of temporal prevalence dynamics, and retrieve each species’ extinction risk from the International Union for Conservation of Nature (IUCN) Red List. Fewer than 10% of local populations show consistent increasing or decreasing prevalence over time, with most exhibiting random patterns of temporal change, especially marine populations. Overall, higher extinction risk is associated with a higher frequency of decreasing local prevalence, and vice-versa for increasing prevalence, against a backdrop of complex links between extinction risk and local temporal dynamics. Our results suggest that directional changes in species local prevalence could be harbingers of future changes in global threat status, and highlight how leveraging assemblage monitoring data can aid conservation efforts and extinction assessments.
items.title_zh: 将物种局部趋势（来自群落监测）与全球灭绝风险联系起来
items.abstract_zh: 尽管全球生物多样性格局正在重塑，但大多数物种的灭绝风险评估仍然不足，如何理解全球受威胁状况与局部种群趋势是否一致仍然是一个重大挑战。本文利用来自978个海洋和陆地生物群落（采样时间至少20年，主要来自温带地区）的2362个物种的6万多个种群数据，评估了种群的时间流行趋势是否与其全球灭绝风险相符。我们将每个种群归入五个时间流行动态类别之一，并从国际自然保护联盟（IUCN）红色名录中获取每个物种的灭绝风险。结果显示，仅有不到10%的局部种群的流行率随时间推移呈现持续上升或下降的趋势，大多数种群，尤其是海洋种群，表现出随机的时间变化模式。总体而言，较高的灭绝风险与局部流行率下降的频率较高相关，反之亦然，这与灭绝风险和局部时间动态之间复杂的联系密切相关。我们的研究结果表明，物种局部流行率的定向变化可能预示着未来全球受威胁状况的变化，并强调了如何利用群落监测数据来辅助保护工作和灭绝评估。

items.title: Top-down effects dominate the relationship between plant–herbivorous insect interactions and ecosystem stability
items.publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
items.abstract: Consumptive interactions across trophic levels underpin ecosystem stability. Although theoretical and experimental studies have examined the diversity–stability relationship, empirical evidence linking trophic interactions to ecosystem stability remains limited. Here we evaluate how trophic interactions relate to stability across 430 plant–herbivorous insect networks from temperate and tropical ecosystems. We quantified interaction indicators alongside ecosystem resistance and resilience under drought and wet events. Higher plant diversity was associated with drought resistance but with reduced resilience, and these relationships weakened after accounting for sampling and environmental covariates. In contrast, drought resistance increased with network modularity, whereas resilience decreased with robustness, although these patterns were absent in temperate forests. Diversity and interaction indicators did not predict stability under wet events. Although both directions of trophic interaction–stability relationships were significant, the pathway from trophic interactions to stability (top-down) was stronger than the reverse. Our findings provide large-scale empirical evidence that top-down effects probably dominate the relationship between plant–herbivorous insect interactions and ecosystem stability under climate change. Multitrophic interactions may affect plant diversity–stability relationships. This analysis of 430 empirical plant–herbivore networks suggests that plant–herbivore interactions are a key driver of the temporal stability of ecosystem productivity under climatic disturbance.
items.title_zh: 自上而下的效应主导着植物-植食性昆虫相互作用与生态系统稳定性之间的关系

items.title: A unified analysis of global riverine eDNA reveals common associations of fish biodiversity with drainage characteristics
items.publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
items.abstract: Freshwater biodiversity is declining at a pace that outstrips the capacity of existing monitoring approaches both in temporal and spatial dimensions, highlighting the urgent need for rapid and scalable assessment and attribution of biodiversity states and changes. Here we present a global assessment and unified analysis of riverine fish biodiversity using environmental DNA collected from 1,818 sites across 113 river systems spanning 5 continents. We quantified species richness, functional redundancy, phylogenetic diversity and genetic sequence diversity, and related them to drainage characteristics. Our results showed that environmental DNA effectively captured global patterns of multi-faceted riverine fish biodiversity and disentangled the roles of climate and different aspects of human activities in shaping biodiversity–area relationships. The accumulation of biodiversity with catchment area was consistently enhanced in warmer climates, while human activities weakened this scaling. Further, species richness, functional and genetic sequence diversity exhibited stronger negative responses to human activities in larger catchments. In contrast, phylogenetic diversity was negatively affected by human activities, yet this effect diminished as catchment area increased, highlighting the facet-dependent nature of biodiversity responses to environmental gradients and catchment characteristics. Our findings demonstrate the power of environmental-DNA-based datasets for harmonized, multi-faceted biodiversity assessments, offering a scalable approach for detecting and attributing biodiversity change and informing conservation strategies under accelerating global change. Using environmental DNA from 113 river systems, this study presents a unified analysis of global riverine fish biodiversity to examine how effectively environmental DNA captures multiple facets of biodiversity patterns and how fish biodiversity responds to variation in drainage properties and human activities.
items.title_zh: 对全球河流环境 DNA 的统一分析揭示了鱼类生物多样性与流域特征之间的共同关联

items.title: Increasing forest disturbance enhances habitat suitability for Europe’s large herbivores
items.publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
items.abstract: Forest disturbances have increased in many regions, but how they impact habitat suitability for wildlife remains poorly understood. Here, by combining tracking data on 3,069 individuals of four ungulate species (European bison, moose, red deer and roe deer) with satellite-based maps, we perform a continental, multi-decadal assessment of large herbivore responses to forest disturbance. Despite strong intraspecific variation, all species show an increased selection of disturbed areas for ≥35 years after disturbance. Although the patterns closely reflect species-specific foraging strategies, all species selected more strongly for smaller disturbance patches, depending on the availability of alternative foraging habitats (grasslands and croplands). Model projections across the species’ range extents show positive but regionally varying effects of forest disturbances on habitat suitability between 2000 and 2023. Our findings indicate that forest disturbances can attract large herbivores and that the recent increase in forest disturbances improved habitat suitability for our study species across Europe, highlighting the importance of considering long-term disturbance-related dynamics for wildlife and forest management. Given expected future increases in disturbance, resulting habitat improvements could amplify conflicts with forestry, but also contribute to restoring large herbivores and their ecological functions.
items.title_zh: 森林干扰的增加提高了欧洲大型食草动物的栖息地适宜性
items.abstract_zh: 许多地区的森林干扰日益增多，但其对野生动物栖息地适宜性的影响仍知之甚少。本研究结合对四种有蹄类动物（欧洲野牛、驼鹿、马鹿和狍）共3069个个体的追踪数据和卫星遥感地图，对大型草食动物对森林干扰的响应进行了跨越大陆、跨越数十年的评估。尽管物种内部存在显著差异，但所有物种在干扰发生后至少35年内，对干扰区域的选择均有所增加。虽然这种选择模式与物种特有的觅食策略密切相关，但所有物种都更倾向于选择较小的干扰斑块，具体取决于是否存在其他觅食栖息地（草原和农田）。模型预测显示，在2000年至2023年间，森林干扰对物种分布范围内的栖息地适宜性产生了积极影响，但这种影响存在区域差异。我们的研究结果表明，森林干扰能够吸引大型食草动物，并且近期森林干扰的增加改善了欧洲各地研究物种的栖息地适宜性，这凸显了考虑与干扰相关的长期动态对野生动物和森林管理的重要性。鉴于未来干扰预计会增加，由此带来的栖息地改善可能会加剧与林业的冲突，但也有助于恢复大型食草动物及其生态功能。

items.title: Ecological multifunctionality of watersheds increases with tree species richness
items.publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
items.abstract: Watersheds are natural units and meta-ecosystems of the earth's land surface providing multiple ecological functions. However, little is known about the biodiversity-ecological multifunctionality relationships of watersheds, particularly regarding how these relationships scale to large and complex landscapes. Here, we explore the impact of forest tree species richness on the ecological multifunctionality of watersheds in terms of carbon sequestration, carbon storage, water supply, water regulation, and soil conservation, by utilizing integrated ground-sourced forest inventory datasets comprising 846 forest watersheds from the Global Forest Biodiversity Initiative, the Global Streamflow Indices and Metadata Archive, and remote sensing data products. We find a consistently positive relationship between forest tree species richness and watershed ecological multifunctionality by accounting for factors such as forest structural characteristics and environmental conditions. Furthermore, we find that this biodiversity-multifunctionality link is dependent on spatial scale and climatic context, becoming stronger in larger watersheds but diminishing in arid climatic conditions. These insights enhance our understanding of ecosystem multifunctionality and underscore the importance of considering watershed-scale ecological processes and biodiversity in ecosystem management and conservation strategies.
items.title_zh: 流域的生态多功能性随着树种丰富度的增加
items.abstract_zh: 流域是地球陆地表面的自然单元和元生态系统，提供多种生态功能。然而，人们对流域生物多样性与生态多功能性之间的关系知之甚少，尤其是在大型复杂景观中，这些关系如何变化。本文利用全球森林生物多样性倡议（GFBI）、全球径流指数和元数据档案库（GSIM）以及遥感数据产品，结合包含846个森林流域的地面森林清查数据集，探讨了森林树种丰富度对流域生态多功能性（包括碳固存、碳储存、供水、水资源调节和土壤保持）的影响。研究发现，在考虑森林结构特征和环境条件等因素后，森林树种丰富度与流域生态多功能性之间存在持续的正相关关系。此外，我们还发现，这种生物多样性与多功能性之间的联系取决于空间尺度和气候背景，在较大的流域中更为显著，但在干旱气候条件下则有所减弱。这些见解加深了我们对生态系统多功能性的理解，并强调了在生态系统管理和保护战略中考虑流域尺度生态过程和生物多样性的重要性。

items.title: Year-round marine heat extremes severely impact marine life during the first year at 1.5°C warming
items.publisher: Elsevier BV
items.abstract: Periods of anomalous ocean heat are becoming more intense and persistent, with consequences for biodiversity, food systems, and coastal resilience. Yet ocean impact assessments often emphasize summer, creating a seasonal bias that can underrepresent the year-round consequences of marine heat extremes. In 2023–2024, ocean surface warming exceeded 1.0°C above pre-industrial levels, coinciding with year-round marine heat extremes across much of the ocean. Here, we provide a rapid global assessment of marine impacts during this exceptional year. We show that summer impacts were frequent and severe, but 29% of non-tropical impacts occurred in cooler seasons. Events involving compound hazards occurred across seasons, though their timing varied by hazard type. Summer assessments alone are therefore insufficient to capture when, where, and how ocean heat threatens marine ecosystems. Rapid, year-round assessments are needed to understand how anomalous heat affects marine ecosystems and dependent societies, while informing preparedness plans for inevitable future extremes.
items.title_zh: 在气温升高1.5摄氏度的第一年，全年海洋极端高温会对海洋生物造成严重影响
items.abstract_zh: 异常海洋高温事件的强度和持续时间都在增加，对生物多样性、粮食系统和沿海地区的韧性都造成了影响。然而，海洋影响评估通常侧重于夏季，这种季节性偏差可能会低估海洋极端高温事件全年造成的影响。2023-2024年，海洋表面温度比工业化前水平高出1.0°C以上，同时，海洋大部分地区也出现了全年极端高温事件。本文对这一特殊年份的海洋影响进行了快速的全球评估。结果表明，夏季的影响频繁且严重，但29%的非热带地区影响发生在较冷的季节。复合灾害事件跨越多个季节发生，但其发生时间因灾害类型而异。因此，仅进行夏季评估不足以全面了解海洋高温何时、何地以及如何威胁海洋生态系统。我们需要开展快速的全年评估，以了解异常高温如何影响海洋生态系统及其依赖的社会，并为应对未来不可避免的极端事件制定准备计划。

items.title: Biodiversity recovery is slow following clear-cut harvest of boreal forests
items.publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
items.abstract: Boreal forests are important reservoirs of biodiversity, carbon and timber stocks. However, timber harvest can alter biodiversity in these forests without clear evidence on the duration needed for biotic groups to recover. Resilience of boreal forest biodiversity to clear-cut harvest was examined with a meta-analysis of 190 datasets from boreal and hemi-boreal forests of Europe/Russia and North America for arthropods, birds, small mammals, lichens, bryophytes and vascular plants. We modelled similarity of community composition between harvested and unharvested stands versus years post harvest. In approximately half of cases, predicted times for recovery to pre-harvest composition were ≤30 years. In other cases, recovery took much longer or had not occurred within the timeframe of our data; for example, in conifer forest: >100 years (bryophytes), >55 years (small mammals), ~95 years (lichens) and ~85 years (vascular plants). Saproxylic beetles showed no resilience within the 16 (conifer forest) or 29 (mixed forest) years post harvest for which we had data. Recovery generally took longer in conifer and mixed than in broadleaf forests, which always showed either resistance (bryophytes, vascular plants) or resilience with recovery within 12–25 years. Conserving biodiversity in boreal forests will require extended rotations, management for ‘old forest’ structural elements and areas protected from harvesting.
items.title_zh: 北方森林遭到皆伐后，生物多样性恢复缓慢
items.abstract_zh: 北方森林是生物多样性、碳汇和木材储量的重要储存库。然而，伐木会改变这些森林的生物多样性，但目前尚无明确证据表明生物群落需要多长时间才能恢复。本研究利用来自欧洲/俄罗斯和北美北方及半北方森林的190个数据集，对节肢动物、鸟类、小型哺乳动物、地衣、苔藓植物和维管植物进行了荟萃分析，以考察北方森林生物多样性对皆伐的恢复力。我们构建了采伐林分和未采伐林分群落组成相似性与采伐后年限的关系模型。在约一半的案例中，预测恢复到采伐前组成所需的时间≤30年。在其他案例中，恢复所需时间更长，或者在我们的数据时间范围内尚未发生。例如，在针叶林中：苔藓植物的恢复期超过100年，小型哺乳动物超过55年，地衣超过95年，维管植物超过85年。在我们掌握数据的采伐后16年（针叶林）或29年（混交林）内，腐木甲虫均未表现出恢复力。针叶林和混交林的恢复时间通常比阔叶林更长，阔叶林总是表现出抵抗力（苔藓植物、维管植物）或恢复力，并在12-25年内恢复。保护北方森林的生物多样性需要延长轮伐期，对“老林”结构要素进行管理，并保护特定区域免受采伐。

items.title: Food web complexity underlies biodiversity effects on ecosystem functioning
items.publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
items.abstract: Biodiversity change has elicited widespread concern over the consequences for functions and services provided by ecosystems1–3. Despite extensive evidence for a positive effect of biodiversity on ecosystem functioning within a single trophic level4,5, how this biodiversity effect varies with multi-trophic food web structure remains unresolved6 even though most ecosystems contain two to six trophic levels7. We investigate how food web complexity modulates biodiversity–ecosystem functioning relationships in nature by quantifying energy fluxes as proxies for two principal ecosystem functions8—primary consumption and predation—in 318 highly resolved, complex food webs from marine, lake, stream and soil ecosystems. Ecosystem functioning increased consistently with taxon richness across all trophic levels and ecosystems, which arose from greater vertical diversity (that is, maximum trophic level9) and trophic complementarity of predators in more taxonomically diverse food webs. Furthermore, predator trophic complementarity10,11 increased predation fluxes in all freshwater ecosystem types. These findings highlight the threat of trophic downgrading to critical ecosystem functions (for example, biological control and maintenance of biodiversity and ecosystem stability) provided by predators12,13, which are typically most vulnerable to anthropogenic disturbances14,15. Our study demonstrates that the consequences of biodiversity change are deeply entangled within the web of life, emphasizing the need to conserve the trophic complexity underlying biodiversity–ecosystem function relationships. Analyses of the relationship between taxon richness and multi-trophic ecosystem functioning across marine, lake, stream and soil ecosystems show that food web complexity underlies biodiversity effects on ecosystem functioning.
items.title_zh: 食物网的复杂性是生物多样性对生态系统功能产生影响的根本原因

items.title: Global inequality in roadkill burden concentrates collision risk on threatened species in low- and middle-income countries
items.publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
items.abstract: Global development relies on vast and expanding road networks, yet the global distribution of the wildlife mortality they cause remains poorly quantified. Here we show, using researcher-led surveys, global citizen-science records and a high-resolution national dataset for China, that wildlife-vehicle collisions disproportionately burden biodiversity in low- and middle-income countries. After standardising for species pools and sampling effort, low- and middle-income countries bear a heavier roadkill burden than high-income countries, with the strongest disparities reaching 2–4-fold for threatened vertebrates but much weaker contrasts for non-threatened species. This reflects elevated collision rates among threatened fauna rather than a broader list of affected species. In China, the same pattern unfolds along a land-use intensity gradient: transformed landscapes elevate risk for common generalists while progressively filtering threatened taxa from the roadscape. Overall, expanding transport networks concentrate contemporary collision burden on threatened biodiversity in low- and middle-income countries. This study shows that wildlife-vehicle collisions place a heavier standardized burden on threatened vertebrates in low- and middle-income countries, highlighting an overlooked inequality in infrastructure-related biodiversity loss.
items.title_zh: 全球道路动物死亡负担的不平等加剧了中低收入国家濒危物种面临的碰撞风险
items.abstract_zh: 全球发展依赖于庞大且不断扩张的道路网络，然而，道路交通事故造成的野生动物死亡的全球分布情况仍缺乏量化。本文利用研究人员主导的调查、全球公民科学记录以及中国高分辨率国家数据集，揭示了野生动物与车辆碰撞对中低收入国家生物多样性造成的负担尤为严重。在对物种库和采样工作量进行标准化后，中低收入国家的道路交通事故造成的野生动物死亡负担高于高收入国家，其中受威胁脊椎动物的差异最为显著，可达2-4倍，而非受威胁物种的差异则小得多。这反映的是受威胁动物群的碰撞率较高，而非受影响物种范围更广。在中国，同样的模式沿着土地利用强度梯度展开：景观的改变增加了常见广食性物种的风险，同时逐渐将受威胁物种从道路环境中剔除。总体而言，不断扩张的交通网络将当前的碰撞负担集中在中低收入国家受威胁的生物多样性上。

items.title: Contrasting patterns of alpine biodiversity across mountains and taxa worldwide
items.publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
items.abstract: The alpine biome, located at higher elevations of mountains worldwide, supports unique biodiversity and provides important ecosystem contributions to people. Despite the growing recognition of mountain biodiversity in international policy frameworks, substantial gaps remain in our understanding of how alpine biodiversity varies across mountain systems, undermining estimates of its conservation value and consequently effective conservation strategies. Here, we curate a dataset on alpine biodiversity, incorporating expert-validated data on species’ elevational ranges for vascular plants, mammals, birds, and reptiles across 32 mountain ranges worldwide. We show that alpine biodiversity hotspots are concentrated in Neotropical regions, while most temperate regions represent coldspots with lower species richness. These patterns persist whether considering species with broad elevational ranges or only those strictly confined to the alpine zone. Unlike the classical latitudinal gradient of biodiversity, alpine richness patterns show no consistent relationship with latitude, highlighting the importance of regional history, landscape structure, and biogeographical processes.
items.title_zh: 全球不同山脉和类群的高山生物多样性模式对比
items.abstract_zh: 高山生物群落位于全球山脉的高海拔地区，孕育着独特的生物多样性，并为人类提供重要的生态系统服务。尽管国际政策框架日益重视山地生物多样性，但我们对高山生物多样性在不同山地系统中的差异仍知之甚少，这影响了对其保护价值的评估，进而影响了有效保护策略的制定。本文构建了一个高山生物多样性数据集，其中包含经专家验证的全球32个山脉中维管植物、哺乳动物、鸟类和爬行动物物种的海拔分布范围数据。研究表明，高山生物多样性热点地区集中在新热带地区，而大多数温带地区则属于物种丰富度较低的冷点。无论考虑海拔分布范围广泛的物种，还是仅考虑那些严格局限于高山带的物种，这些模式都成立。与经典的生物多样性纬度梯度不同，高山物种丰富度模式与纬度没有一致的关系，这凸显了区域历史、景观结构和生物地理过程的重要性。

items.title: A meta-analysis of carbon losses and gains from tropical moist forest degradation and regeneration
items.publisher: American Association for the Advancement of Science (AAAS)
items.abstract: Aboveground carbon (AGC) fluxes from deforestation and subsequent regrowth in tropical moist forest (TMF) are increasingly well characterized, but carbon losses and gains following partial disturbance are uncertain. We synthesized 146 studies quantifying postdisturbance AGC changes relative to undisturbed forests across TMF. Immediate AGC losses (mean ± 1 SD; 2.5 ± 2.3 years after disturbance) following partial anthropogenic disturbances were greatest for forest fires (49 ± 26%), selective logging (34 ± 20%), and edge effects (31 ± 19%). Higher-frequency and -intensity disturbances significantly increased carbon loss. After 20 years of regeneration, AGC stock was higher in recovering degraded forests (41 to 117%) compared to secondary regrowth forests after complete deforestation (1 to 74%), indicating greater regeneration potential when forest structure is preserved. Our compiled database and associated meta-analysis improve accuracy and completeness for carbon inventory reporting and modeling. Substantial AGC losses and gains from distinct degradation and recovery processes are now better characterized, serving as an evidence base for policies to halt degradation and foster recovery for climate mitigation.
items.title_zh: 热带湿润森林退化和再生过程中碳损失和碳增益的荟萃分析
items.abstract_zh: 热带湿润森林（TMF）地上碳（AGC）通量因森林砍伐和后续再生而产生的特征已日益明确，但部分干扰后的碳损失和增加情况仍不确定。我们综合分析了146项研究，这些研究量化了TMF中干扰后AGC相对于未干扰森林的变化。部分人为干扰后，AGC的即时损失（平均值±1个标准差；干扰后2.5±2.3年）在森林火灾（49±26%）、选择性伐木（34±20%）和边缘效应（31±19%）中最为显著。干扰频率和强度越高，碳损失越显著。经过20年的再生，恢复中的退化森林的AGC储量（41%至117%）高于完全森林砍伐后的次生再生林（1%至74%），表明森林结构得到保护时，再生潜力更大。我们汇编的数据库和相关的荟萃分析提高了碳清单报告和建模的准确性和完整性。不同退化和恢复过程中的大量AGC损失和收益现在得到了更好的描述，为制定阻止退化和促进恢复以实现气候减缓的政策提供了证据基础。

items.title: Can habitat modification in the native range promote invasion?
items.publisher: Elsevier BV
items.abstract: The anthropogenically induced adaptation to invade (AIAI) hypothesis posits that selection in human-modified habitats within native ranges can adapt populations to invade similarly altered environments elsewhere. Although widely invoked, empirical tests of this hypothesis remain limited because disentangling native-range adaptation from post-introduction evolution is challenging. Here, we clarify how anthropogenic disturbance creates repeatable selective regimes and demonstrate how targeted sampling, population genomics, and genotype-environment associations can disentangle native-range adaptation from post-introduction evolution. Incorporating genomic offset, genetic architecture, nongenetic changes, experiments, and temporal data further strengthens inference. These insights and approaches establish the AIAI hypothesis as a mechanism that explicitly links human disturbance with the evolutionary dynamics of invasive species, providing novel insights into the prediction and management of biological invasions.
items.title_zh: 在原生地范围内改变栖息地是否会促进入侵？
items.abstract_zh: 人为诱导入侵适应（AIAI）假说认为，在原生栖息地中，人为改造的环境选择可以使种群适应入侵其他类似改造的环境。尽管该假说被广泛引用，但由于难以将原生栖息地适应与引入后的进化区分开来，因此对其的实证检验仍然有限。本文阐明了人为干扰如何产生可重复的选择机制，并展示了如何通过靶向抽样、群体基因组学和基因型-环境关联分析来区分原生栖息地适应与引入后的进化。纳入基因组偏移、遗传结构、非遗传变化、实验和时间序列数据进一步增强了推断的可靠性。这些见解和方法将AIAI假说确立为一种将人为干扰与入侵物种进化动态明确联系起来的机制，为生物入侵的预测和管理提供了新的视角。

items.title: Evaluating the biodiversity commitments of Earth’s keystone corporations
items.publisher: Elsevier BV
items.abstract: Over the past 50 years, large transnational "keystone" corporations have concentrated power and gained significant influence over the world's resource reserves, production, and trade. The Kunming-Montreal Global Biodiversity Framework emphasizes the crucial role of businesses in setting and disclosing targets to mitigate their impact on nature. In this study, we identified 180 keystone corporations from highly concentrated sectors with significant environmental impacts and assessed their biodiversity commitments. Our findings reveal that while 79% of firms have made some form of biodiversity pledge, only 13% have reported sufficiently detailed, transparent, and specific commitments ("robust commitments") to allow others to assess if the targets have been met—a key prerequisite of accountability. We discuss future directions and underscore the urgent need for companies, governments, and civil society—including the research community—to work collaboratively to develop, implement, and monitor credible corporate strategies that drive meaningful action for nature.
items.title_zh: 评估全球各大企业的生物多样性保护承诺
items.abstract_zh: 企业对自然环境的影响越来越大。少数大型企业掌控着那些对全球环境有重大影响的行业。不过，企业也可以在阻止和扭转生物多样性丧失方面发挥关键作用。尤其是大型跨国企业，可以利用自身影响力来推动整个行业的可持续发展。为了实现这一必要的变革，企业必须明确阐述自己在生物多样性保护方面的承诺，并如实汇报相关情况。只有公开、清晰地披露这些承诺，社会才能要求企业为其在生物多样性保护方面的行为负责。我们的研究指出，所调查的那些具有影响力的大型企业，其大部分生物多样性保护承诺目前还不够清晰，无法满足问责的要求。我们分析了企业生物多样性报告方面的不足之处，并提出了若干改进建议。利用科学、商业界、监管机构和社会各界的力量，共同推动企业更好地设定和报告与生物多样性相关的目标。我们提供了一种经过验证的评估方法，用于衡量企业在其生物多样性承诺方面的清晰度。这些数据可以被决策者用来评估企业在未来在生物多样性报告方面的改进或退步情况。

items.title: Leveraging thermal regimes and connectivity networks to promote evolutionary adaptation across coral reef seascapes
items.publisher: Elsevier BV
items.abstract: The rise of marine heat waves threatens coral reefs, potentially outpacing adaptation. Managing reef seascapes to support thermal evolution is well recognized, but specific actions and site prioritizations are only emerging. We present an operational framework that leverages heat-wave exposure and larval dispersal patterns to create reef functional units with distinct roles and management needs. Using the Great Barrier Reef, we explore the emergent management portfolio and find complementary regional priorities: protection and outplanting for assisted evolution are prioritized in southern reefs, while northern reefs serve as valuable heat-tolerant sources. Strategic, evolution-informed management is critical for reef survival as climate pressures intensify.
items.title_zh: 利用热环境与连接网络来促进珊瑚礁生态系统的进化适应能力
items.abstract_zh: 海洋热浪的频繁发生对珊瑚礁构成了威胁，其破坏速度可能超过珊瑚礁的适应能力。虽然人们已经认识到有必要对珊瑚礁进行管理，以帮助其适应气候变化，但具体的管理措施和重点区域仍需进一步明确。我们提出了一个操作性框架，该框架利用热浪的影响以及珊瑚幼体的扩散模式，将珊瑚礁划分为具有不同功能和管理需求的区域。以大堡礁为例，我们发现了不同的管理重点：在南部珊瑚礁，应重点采取保护和重新种植珊瑚的措施来帮助珊瑚礁适应气候变化；而北部珊瑚礁则可作为耐热珊瑚的宝贵来源。随着气候压力的加剧，采取基于进化原理的战略性管理措施对于珊瑚礁的生存至关重要。

items.title: Disturbance regimes drive widespread plant range disequilibrium in Europe alongside climate change
items.publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
items.abstract: Species distributions often fail to match climatically suitable areas, resulting in range disequilibrium. Although recent studies have focused on mismatches arising from lags in biotic responses to climate change (for example, extinction and colonization lags), disturbance processes may also determine whether species occupy otherwise climatically suitable areas, for example, by altering vegetation structure and light regimes. Here we assess climate-change and disturbance-driven disequilibrium for 3,047 vascular plant species across Europe using species distribution models and >1.1 million vegetation plots. Almost all species (99%) show disturbance-driven disequilibrium, revealing mismatches that are strongly structured along disturbance gradients, consistent with alternative vegetation states. We identified disequilibrium associated with recent climate change in 52% of species, with ranges best predicted by climates 10–18 years before sampling and most pronounced among closed-canopy species, probably reflecting under-canopy microclimatic buffering. These findings demonstrate that climate change and disturbance jointly shape widespread disequilibrium in European plant distributions, with disturbance regimes strongly structuring the realization of climatic suitability across contemporary landscapes. Accounting for both disturbance regimes and temporal lags in climate response is therefore essential for improving biodiversity forecasts and guiding conservation strategies.
items.title_zh: 干扰机制与气候变化共同导致欧洲植物分布范围普遍失衡
items.abstract_zh: 物种分布往往与气候适宜区域不匹配，导致分布范围失衡。尽管近期研究主要集中于生物对气候变化响应滞后（例如，灭绝和定殖滞后）所导致的不匹配，但干扰过程也可能决定物种是否占据原本气候适宜的区域，例如，通过改变植被结构和光照条件。本文利用物种分布模型和超过110万个植被样方，评估了欧洲3047种维管植物的气候变化和干扰驱动的分布失衡情况。几乎所有物种（99%）都表现出干扰驱动的分布失衡，揭示出沿干扰梯度呈现显著结构化的不匹配，这与不同的植被状态相一致。我们发现52%的物种的分布失衡与近期气候变化相关，这些物种的分布范围最能根据采样前10-18年的气候进行预测，且在郁闭度较高的物种中最为显著，这可能反映了林下微气候的缓冲作用。这些研究结果表明，气候变化和干扰共同塑造了欧洲植物分布的广泛失衡，其中干扰机制对当代景观中气候适宜性的实现起着至关重要的作用。因此，同时考虑干扰机制和气候响应的时间滞后对于改进生物多样性预测和指导保护策略至关重要。

items.title: Robust estimates of biodiversity change require high-resolution time series
items.publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
items.abstract: Robust estimates of biodiversity change are essential to inform management and conservation, and to address global biodiversity loss. However, common temporal data limitations may compromise trend accuracy. Here, we test how temporal resolution influences biodiversity trends using 1,353 river invertebrate time series collected annually for ≥ 10 years across 18 European countries. We simulate reduced sampling frequencies and durations and compare these trends to the complete time series. Reducing frequency from annual to every 2–6 years resulted in 87–73% of sites matching in trend directions, but only 78–39% matching in magnitude. Reducing duration from 10 to 9–2 years resulted in 88–52% direction matches and 86–8% magnitude matches. Similar results were observed for longer time series ( ≥ 20 years). Additionally, a comparison of two real-world monitoring datasets with different temporal resolutions shows that 53% of sites matched in direction, but only 12% in magnitude. Our findings indicate that biodiversity change magnitude is more sensitive to temporal resolution than direction. Consequently, accurate estimates of both direction and magnitude require high-resolution time series, whereas lower-resolution data may only reliably capture direction. These results highlight the value and limitations of temporal biodiversity data, and help plan future monitoring.
items.title_zh: 对生物多样性变化进行可靠的估计需要高分辨率时间序列数据
items.abstract_zh: 对生物多样性变化进行可靠的评估对于指导管理和保护以及应对全球生物多样性丧失至关重要。然而，常见的时序数据局限性可能会影响趋势的准确性。本文利用来自18个欧洲国家、每年收集至少10年的1353个河流无脊椎动物时间序列数据，检验了时间分辨率如何影响生物多样性趋势。我们模拟了降低采样频率和持续时间的情况，并将这些趋势与完整的时间序列进行比较。将采样频率从每年降低到每2-6年，导致87-73%的采样点在趋势方向上一致，但只有78-39%的采样点在趋势幅度上一致。将持续时间从10年缩短到9-2年，导致88-52%的采样点在趋势方向上一致，86-8%的采样点在趋势幅度上一致。对于更长时间序列（≥20年），也观察到了类似的结果。此外，对两个具有不同时间分辨率的实际监测数据集进行比较发现，53%的采样点在趋势方向上一致，但只有12%的采样点在趋势幅度上一致。我们的研究结果表明，生物多样性变化的幅度对时间分辨率的敏感性高于方向。因此，要准确估计变化的方向和幅度，需要高分辨率的时间序列数据，而低分辨率数据可能只能可靠地捕捉方向。这些结果凸显了时间序列生物多样性数据的价值和局限性，并有助于规划未来的监测工作。

items.title: The forest of knowledge under global change
items.publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
items.abstract: Amazonia harbours more than 10% of the terrestrial biodiversity of the Earth 1 and more than 400 Indigenous groups 2 . So far, however, no study has assessed how climate change and the loss of Indigenous languages may simultaneously impact its biological and cultural heritage. Here, to bridge this gap, we first assembled a database of 90,536 reports from 700 references to understand the societal benefits that native plants provide across all countries of the Amazon basin. We found that humans utilize 5,796 native plant species, which amounts to one-third of the known Amazon vascular seed plant flora. Next, analysing 8,429 species distribution models across three future climate scenarios (SSP1–2.6, SSP3–7.0 and SSP5–8.5), we show that climate change will produce a greater reduction in the ranges of utilized than of non-utilized species by 2060–2080. Locally, Indigenous cultures may lose an average of 28–34% of their utilized plant species and 18–23% of their associated services from climate change. Regionally, the loss of threatened Indigenous languages may result in a 26% reduction in the Amazonian knowledge pool. Overall, our results point to the strong climate and language vulnerability of Amazonian biocultural heritage. At the same time, these results—together with our publicly available dataset—may serve to guide biocultural restoration and reverse the growing global change effects on ecosystems and cultural traditions.
items.title_zh: 全球变化下的知识森林
items.abstract_zh: 对生物多样性变化进行可靠的评估对于指导管理和保护以及应对全球生物多样性丧失至关重要。然而，常见的时序数据局限性可能会影响趋势的准确性。本文利用来自18个欧洲国家、每年收集至少10年的1353个河流无脊椎动物时间序列数据，检验了时间分辨率如何影响生物多样性趋势。我们模拟了降低采样频率和持续时间的情况，并将这些趋势与完整的时间序列进行比较。将采样频率从每年降低到每2-6年，导致87-73%的采样点在趋势方向上一致，但只有78-39%的采样点在趋势幅度上一致。将持续时间从10年缩短到9-2年，导致88-52%的采样点在趋势方向上一致，86-8%的采样点在趋势幅度上一致。对于更长时间序列（≥20年），也观察到了类似的结果。此外，对两个具有不同时间分辨率的实际监测数据集进行比较发现，53%的采样点在趋势方向上一致，但只有12%的采样点在趋势幅度上一致。我们的研究结果表明，生物多样性变化的幅度对时间分辨率的敏感性高于方向。因此，要准确估计变化的方向和幅度，需要高分辨率的时间序列数据，而低分辨率数据可能只能可靠地捕捉方向。这些结果凸显了时间序列生物多样性数据的价值和局限性，并有助于规划未来的监测工作。

items.title: European challenges
items.publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
items.abstract: Europe’s habitats are changing and so too are its nature laws, and people’s attitudes to biodiversity.
items.title_zh: 欧洲的挑战

items.title: Remote sensing delivers tropical forest resilience monitoring for the Global Biodiversity Framework
items.publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
items.abstract: Tropical forests sustain a disproportionate share of global biodiversity and of nature’s contributions to people, yet they are increasingly destabilized by interacting pressures from climate change, land-use change and intensifying disturbance regimes. Understanding and monitoring forest resilience — the capacity to resist, absorb, recover from and adapt to disturbance — requires scalable approaches that integrate biodiversity, ecosystem structure and function across space and time. In this Review, we discuss how the essential biodiversity variables (EBV) framework, enabled by satellite remote sensing, has improved understanding of forest resilience under global environmental change. Remotely sensed EBV proxies derived from multispectral, thermal, hyperspectral, radar, light detection and ranging (LiDAR) and solar-induced fluorescence observations capture multiple facets of biodiversity and ecosystem dynamics. However, scale dependence, observational biases and the limited capacity of current EBVs to resolve fine-grained biological and mechanistic processes underpinning resilience (particularly species turnover and functional reassembly) are critical limitations. Emerging opportunities, including data fusion, next-generation satellite missions and integration with in situ observations, will advance the operationalization of EBV-based resilience monitoring, particularly in the context of the Kunming–Montreal Global Biodiversity Framework. Advances in remote sensing now enable the detection of multiple properties of tropical forest biodiversity. This Review discusses how remotely sensed biodiversity facets and essential biodiversity variables can be used to draw inference about tropical forest resilience to global change.
items.title_zh: 遥感技术为全球生物多样性框架提供热带森林恢复力监测
items.abstract_zh: 热带森林承载着全球生物多样性及其对人类自然贡献中不成比例的份额，然而，气候变化、土地利用变化和日益加剧的干扰机制等相互作用的压力正使其日益不稳定。理解和监测森林的恢复力——即抵御、吸收、恢复和适应干扰的能力——需要可扩展的方法，将生物多样性、生态系统结构和功能在空间和时间上整合起来。在本综述中，我们探讨了卫星遥感技术如何利用基本生物多样性变量（EBV）框架来增进我们对全球环境变化下森林恢复力的理解。基于多光谱、热红外、高光谱、雷达、激光雷达（LiDAR）和太阳诱导荧光观测的遥感EBV指标能够捕捉生物多样性和生态系统动态的多个方面。然而，尺度依赖性、观测偏差以及当前EBV指标在解析支撑恢复力的精细生物学和机制过程（特别是物种更替和功能重组）方面的局限性是关键的。数据融合、下一代卫星任务以及与现场观测的整合等新兴机遇，将推动基于EBV的恢复力监测的实施，尤其是在昆明-蒙特利尔全球生物多样性框架的背景下。

items.title: Models used for Red List assessments underestimate climate-related extinction risk of range-shifting species
items.publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
items.abstract: Climate change causes species redistribution and elevates extinction risk, making the early identification of vulnerable species critical for timely conservation. The International Union for Conservation of Nature Red List provides guidelines for assessing climate-related extinction risk using species distribution models and spatially explicit population models. Here we present a systematic evaluation of these guidelines based on simulations of virtual species with diverse life-history traits and range dynamics. We find that, while species distribution models provide adequate warning times for range-contracting species, they consistently underestimate extinction risk for range-shifting species. This is due to a concave relationship between population size and habitat loss, which contradicts the linear assumption in the Red List guidelines. Probabilistic extinction estimates from spatially explicit population models provide a belated warning for all species, particularly for highly threatened ones. Our results reveal key limitations of current Red List guidelines under climate change. Based on our findings, we provide tentative recommendations for updating the International Union for Conservation of Nature Red List guidelines.
items.title_zh: 用于红色名录评估的模型低估了气候变化导致的物种分布范围迁移的灭绝风险
items.abstract_zh: 气候变化导致物种重新分布并加剧灭绝风险，因此及早识别脆弱物种对于及时保护至关重要。国际自然保护联盟（IUCN）红色名录提供了利用物种分布模型和空间显式种群模型评估气候相关灭绝风险的指南。本文基于具有不同生活史特征和分布动态的虚拟物种模拟，对这些指南进行了系统评估。我们发现，虽然物种分布模型能够为分布范围缩小的物种提供足够的预警时间，但它们始终低估了分布范围转移物种的灭绝风险。这是由于种群规模与栖息地丧失之间存在凹形关系，这与红色名录指南中的线性假设相矛盾。空间显式种群模型的概率性灭绝估计能够为所有物种提供滞后的预警，尤其对于高度受威胁的物种而言。我们的研究结果揭示了当前红色名录指南在气候变化背景下的关键局限性。基于这些发现，我们提出了更新国际自然保护联盟红色名录指南的初步建议。

items.title: Implementation of the EU Nature Restoration Regulation requires a shift from restoration targets to restoration landscapes
items.publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
items.abstract: The EU’s Nature Restoration Regulation has created unprecedented momentum for ecosystem restoration. Its success now depends on translating ambitious targets into spatially coordinated restoration landscapes supported by effective governance, long-term financing and broad societal engagement.
items.title_zh: 欧盟自然恢复条例的实施需要从恢复目标转向恢复景观。

items.title: Species range contractions in geographic and environmental space
items.publisher: Elsevier BV
items.abstract: Species range contractions are a defining feature of the Anthropocene. Given their prevalence, a key question arises: do range contractions follow consistent patterns? Empirical studies have produced mixed results, revealing some emergent patterns, but also considerable variation among taxa. Here, we present a framework that seeks to explain this variation, conceptualising range contractions as the outcome of the interplay between species' intrinsic population growth rates and the impact of threats across environmental gradients. Our framework shows how four primary patterns of range contraction arise, with a fifth emerging under incomplete threat spread. By describing when, where, and why particular patterns of decline occur, our framework advances understanding of species' responses to global change and provides a basis for more generalisable conservation strategies.
items.title_zh: 物种在地理和环境空间上的分布范围缩小
items.abstract_zh: 物种分布范围的缩小是人类世的一个显著特征。鉴于这种现象的普遍性，一个关键问题是：物种分布范围的缩小是否遵循某种规律性模式？实证研究得出了不同的结果：虽然有一些明显的模式，但不同物种之间也存在很大差异。在这里，我们提出了一个框架来解释这种差异。该框架将物种分布范围的缩小视为物种自身的种群增长率与环境因素相互作用的结果。我们的框架解释了四种主要的物种分布范围缩小模式，而在威胁分布不均的情况下，还会出现第五种模式。通过阐明物种分布范围缩小发生的时间、地点和原因，该框架有助于我们更好地理解物种对全球变化的反应，同时为制定更有效的保护策略提供依据。

items.title: Biodiversity buffers forest ecosystems from compound climate extremes
items.publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
items.abstract: Forest ecosystems provide key ecological, social, and climate benefits, yet their functions are potentially threatened by rising compound extremes characterised by simultaneous heat and drought or moisture excess. Here, we explore how forests resist and recover from compound heat and moisture extremes and how tree diversity mediates these responses, using U.S. forest inventory data along with satellite-based stability estimates. We find that compound extremes result in lower forest resistance and recovery than individual extremes. Compound extremes tend to exhibit synergistic effects, causing greater negative impacts than the sum of individual extremes. Compound heat and drought have slightly stronger destabilising effects than compound heat and moisture excess. Higher tree diversity consistently improves resistance and recovery under both individual and compound extremes. Our findings suggest that focusing solely on individual climate extremes is likely to underestimate the impacts of compound extremes and to increase uncertainty in projections of terrestrial carbon-cycle feedbacks, while also highlighting the critical role of tree diversity in mitigating these threats under future climate conditions.
items.title_zh: 生物多样性能够缓冲森林生态系统免受复合极端气候的影响
items.abstract_zh: 森林生态系统提供重要的生态、社会和气候效益，但其功能正受到复合极端气候事件（以高温和干旱或水分过剩同时发生为特征）日益增多的潜在威胁。本文利用美国森林资源清查数据和基于卫星的稳定性评估，探讨了森林如何抵御和恢复复合极端高温和水分，以及树木多样性如何调节这些响应。我们发现，复合极端气候事件导致森林的抵抗力和恢复能力低于单一极端气候事件。复合极端气候事件往往表现出协同效应，其负面影响大于单一极端气候事件的总和。复合高温和干旱的破坏性影响略强于复合高温和水分过剩。较高的树木多样性始终能够提高森林在单一极端气候事件和复合极端气候事件下的抵抗力和恢复能力。我们的研究结果表明，仅关注单一极端气候事件可能会低估复合极端气候事件的影响，并增加陆地碳循环反馈预测的不确定性，同时也凸显了树木多样性在未来气候条件下缓解这些威胁的关键作用。

items.title: The evolution and diversification of Cetacea
items.publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
items.abstract: Cetaceans, that is, whales, dolphins and porpoises, have rightfully been deemed a prime example of macroevolution. Few other animal groups document such radical morphological change in their fossil record, culminating in a wide range of extant morphological and phylogenetic diversity. This diversity has spurred intensive study of the clade, with advances in quantitative methods since the turn of the century facilitating new insights into cetacean evolutionary dynamics. The story of cetacean evolution is now more detailed than ever before, from terrestrial origins at the river’s edge in early Eocene Indo-Pakistan to their modern role at the apex of marine ecosystems. This story has the power to inform scientists on how living species will fare in the face of unprecedentedly rapid ecological change. In this Review, I provide a contemporary summary of cetacean macroevolutionary patterns and outline the key events that have influenced their evolutionary history. Despite an expanding understanding of this enigmatic group, many questions remain unanswered, and I outline some key areas that should focus future research efforts. Cetaceans are a highly diverse and enigmatic group of animals with a well-documented evolutionary history. This Review describes the macroevolutionary and palaeobiological history of Cetacea, from their terrestrial ancestry through to their modern aquatic forms.
items.title_zh: 鲸目动物的演化和多样化

items.title: Monitoring nature-based solutions is key for compliance, co-creation and practice improvement
items.publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
items.abstract: In a time of interconnected social, political and environmental crises, international commitments to act on climate change and biodiversity loss are being put to the test. Upholding these commitments requires us to adopt monitoring and evaluation practices that bridge the gap between international ambitions and local action in cities. For safeguarding current progress and supporting urban nature, we argue that it is critical to reframe monitoring and evaluation as a collective learning process that recognizes people’s everyday knowledge and leverages community involvement to respond to changing conditions. Upholding international environmental commitments calls for monitoring and evaluation practices that bridge international ambitions and local action in cities. This Perspective suggests how to reframe monitoring and evaluation to leverage community involvement to respond to changing conditions.
items.title_zh: 监测基于自然的解决方案对于合规性、共同创造和实践改进至关重要

items.title: Highly fragmented European wetlands with uneven restoration needs
items.publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
items.abstract: European wetlands store large carbon reserves1, but centuries of land use have eroded carbon stocks and biodiversity2. The European Union (EU) Nature Restoration Law (NRL)3 requires at least 30% of wetland ecosystems not in ‘good condition’ to be restored by 2030, yet spatially consistent information on wetland types and condition remains scarce. Using 10-m satellite imagery and machine learning, we map six seminatural open wetland types and land-use disturbance across 38 European countries. Wetlands are highly fragmented, with an estimated 27–33% of wetland area occurring in map-defined patches <25 ha and 7–11% in patches <1 ha, exposing many small sites missed by coarser products. We estimate that human activities affect 20.4 ± 3.4% of wetland areas (95% confidence interval), with inland wetland types most affected, and up to 5 Gt CO2-eq of soil carbon potentially lost relative to an undisturbed baseline. Translating disturbed area into NRL restoration targets, we find that several countries’ pledges are broadly consistent with our 2030 estimates, whereas others lack quantified commitments despite substantial candidate areas identified by our maps. The resulting standardized, high-resolution products provide an EU-wide baseline tailored to the NRL and a reproducible template for linking satellite mapping to restoration targets, supporting progress tracking. Satellite imagery and machine learning used for the mapping of six seminatural open wetland types and land-use disturbance in European countries shows that wetlands are highly fragmented and have uneven restoration needs.
items.title_zh: 欧洲湿地高度分散，修复需求不均衡
items.abstract_zh: 欧洲的湿地拥有大量的碳储备，但数百年的土地利用行为已经破坏了这些地区的碳储存量和生物多样性。欧盟《自然恢复法》要求，到2030年，至少30%处于“不良状态”的湿地生态系统必须得到恢复。然而，关于湿地类型及其状况的详细数据仍然十分匮乏。我们利用10米分辨率的卫星图像和机器学习技术，对38个欧洲国家的六种半自然开放湿地类型以及土地利用状况进行了测绘。结果显示，湿地分布极为分散，估计有27%至33%的湿地面积分布在小于25公顷的斑块中，而7%至11%的湿地面积分布在小于1公顷的斑块中。这些小型湿地很容易被粗略的测绘数据所忽略。我们估计，人类活动影响了20.4%至33%的湿地面积（置信区间为95%），其中内陆湿地受到的影响最大。与未受干扰的基线情况相比，这些湿地可能损失了高达5吉吨的碳储量。将“受干扰区域”转化为NRL恢复目标后，我们发现多个国家的承诺与我们预测的2030年目标大致一致。而另一些国家则缺乏具体的量化承诺，尽管我们的地图已经标出了许多潜在受影响的区域。这些标准化的、高分辨率的成果为整个欧盟提供了基于NRL目标的基准数据，同时也为将卫星测绘结果与恢复目标相结合提供了可复制的模板，从而有助于跟踪进展。

items.title: Marine fish ranges are expanding and shifting deeper across the European continental shelf
items.publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
items.abstract: Understanding how climate change and exploitation affect marine species distribution is key for biodiversity conservation. While warming is typically expected to drive species poleward and into deeper waters, unexpected patterns such as equatorward shifts and shallowing also occur. Fishing pressure may further contract species’ ranges. Yet, the mechanisms underpinning these 3-dimensional range shifts remain largely unresolved. Using 92,961 bottom trawl samples across the European continental shelf, covering 607 fish species over four decades, we show that deepening is predominant, with 60% of populations experiencing an increase in their average depth. Contrary to expectations, latitudinal shifts are balanced, with 49% of populations shifting poleward and 51% equatorward. Here, we quantify how population relocations are driven by the interplay between environmental factors and species traits as species track their optimal ecological niches. We also highlight that the recent reduction in fishing pressure has likely facilitated spatial expansions and increases in populations abundance.
items.title_zh: 海洋鱼类的生活范围正在扩大，它们活动的水域也更深了，这一趋势出现在欧洲大陆架区域
items.abstract_zh: 了解气候变化和过度捕捞对海洋物种分布的影响对于生物多样性保护至关重要。虽然通常认为气候变暖会导致物种向两极深处迁移，但实际上也会出现一些意想不到的现象，比如物种向赤道方向迁移或水域变浅。捕鱼压力还可能进一步缩小物种的活动范围。然而，导致这些三维范围变化的具体机制仍然缺乏明确的解释。通过对比欧洲大陆架上的92,961个底拖网采样数据，涵盖了40年来607种鱼类的研究，我们发现水域变深是主要趋势，有60%的物种活动范围所在的水域深度有所增加。与预期相反的是，纬度方向的迁移并不明显，有49%的物种向两极迁移，而51%的物种向赤道迁移。在这里，我们量化了种群迁移是如何受到环境因素与物种特性相互作用的影响的，而物种则试图找到最适合自己的生态位。此外，我们指出，近期捕鱼压力的减少很可能促进了种群的扩张以及种群数量的增加。

items.title: Biodiversity effects under climate extremes intensify with aridity in grasslands but not forests
items.publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
items.abstract: Biodiversity generally enhances ecosystem productivity, but whether such effects persist or intensify during climate extremes is unclear. Here we synthesized data from 75 biodiversity experiments across grasslands and forests to assess how aridity and soil nutrients modulate plant diversity effects under drought and heat extremes. Biodiversity most strongly enhanced productivity under extreme drought in more arid grasslands but had limited effects in forests under such conditions. More arid grasslands showed enhanced complementarity effects under extreme drought, whereas less arid grasslands favoured selection effects driven by productive species. Heat extremes did not produce comparable context-dependent changes in plant diversity effects across ecosystem types or aridity gradients. Soil nutrients did not have any detectable influence under either drought or heat extremes, suggesting that as climatic stress intensifies, hydric limitations override edaphic constraints. Our synthesis identifies when and where plant diversity most strongly enhances productivity, showing that its effects are the greatest under extreme drought in more arid grasslands.
items.title_zh: 在极端气候下，干旱在草原下对生物多样性的影响加剧，而森林则不然
items.abstract_zh: 生物多样性通常会提高生态系统的生产力，但这种效应在气候极端条件下是否会持续或加剧尚不清楚。在这里，我们整合了来自75项关于草原和森林中生物多样性的研究数据，以评估干旱和高温极端条件下，干旱程度与土壤养分如何调节植物多样性。在更干旱的草原上，生物多样性对生产力的提升作用最为显著，而在森林中则效果有限。在极端干旱条件下，更干旱的草原表现出更强的互补性效应，而较不干旱的草原则更倾向于由具有生产力的物种所驱动的选择效应。高温极端条件并未在不同生态系统类型或干旱梯度上产生类似的植物多样性变化。在干旱或高温极端条件下，土壤养分并未产生任何可检测的影响，这表明随着气候压力的加剧，其他效应可能会减弱。水分限制优先于土壤条件的制约。我们的研究确定了植物多样性在何时何地能最有效地提高生产力，结果表明，在更干旱的草原上，植物多样性对提高生产力的作用最为显著。

items.title: Balancing marine species conservation with cost-effective renewable energy development
items.publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
items.abstract: Climate change is necessitating renewable energy development while contributing to shifting wildlife phenology and distribution. Renewable energy may require anthropogenic activity and wildlife to co-occur. Here we develop a framework to identify trade-offs between financial costs to developers and conservation, considering the critically endangered North Atlantic right whale (Eubalaena glacialis) and offshore wind energy development. By coupling an offshore wind energy construction simulation with a density surface model to quantify the number of right whales exposed to pile-driving noise under ten mitigation scenarios, we highlight mitigation measures, notably seasonal restrictions and noise attenuating devices, that can yield conservation value with minimal financial burden. As societies continue to refine and determine suitable financial and ecological trade-offs for development, frameworks like ours can be useful for exploring conservation challenges to ensure co-benefits for climate and biodiversity. The authors consider the potential conflict between renewable energy development (offshore wind) and wildlife (North Atlantic right whales, Eubalaena glacialis). They demonstrate a framework to identify trade-offs under different scenarios, maximizing conservation with minimal financial burden.
items.title_zh: 平衡海洋物种保护与具有成本效益的可再生能源开发
items.abstract_zh: 气候变化促使人们必须发展可再生能源，同时也导致野生动物物候和分布发生变化。可再生能源的发展可能需要人类活动与野生动物共存。本文构建了一个框架，用于权衡开发商的经济成本与保护成本，并以极度濒危的北大西洋露脊鲸（*Eubalaenaglacialis*）和海上风能开发为例进行分析。我们结合海上风能建设模拟和密度面模型，量化了在十种缓解方案下暴露于打桩噪声的露脊鲸数量，并重点介绍了能够以最小的经济负担带来保护价值的缓解措施，特别是季节性限制和降噪装置。随着社会不断完善和确定合适的经济和生态权衡方案，像我们这样的框架可以帮助我们探索保护方面的挑战，以确保气候和生物多样性的协同效益。

items.title: Consequences of agricultural deforestation and subsequent afforestation on soil biodiversity and ecosystem multifunctionality
items.publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
items.abstract: The Earth is currently in an era where massive deforestation and afforestation coexist. The impact of large-scale agricultural deforestation and the subsequent afforestation on soil biota multidiversity, ecosystem multifunctionality (EMF), and the relationship between soil biota multidiversity and EMF (BEFm) remain unclear. Here, we investigate 405 paired plots along a 4000 km south-north transect, spanning tropical, subtropical, temperate, and boreal zones. We measure 19 ecological functions and sequence soil biota (including bacteria, fungi, archaea, viruses, protists, and invertebrates) and metagenomes. We find that agricultural deforestation reduces soil multitrophic biodiversity by 25% and EMF by 58%, and afforestation has partially restored them, but pristine levels have not been reached. Agricultural deforestation decouples the positive BEFm relationship across four climatic zones, while afforestation restores the positive BEFm relationship in tropics and subtropics but not in temperate and boreal zones. Afforestation in the warmer zone triggers potential multitrophic cascades to enhance EMF, thereby strengthening BEFm relationship. The changes in biogeochemical-cycling genes induced by afforestation exert more significant driving effects on EMF in the warmer zone than the colder zone. Our study provides integrative evidence that climate modulates the recovery of BEFm relationship and offers multitrophic and metagenomic insights into the mechanisms underlying EMF. Large-scale deforestation and afforestation currently coexist. Along a 4,000 km transect, Yu et al. show that deforestation reduces soil multi-diversity by 25% and ecosystem multifunctionality by 58%, while afforestation partially restores both.
items.title_zh: 农业活动导致的森林砍伐以及随后的重新造林行为，对土壤生物多样性和生态系统多功能性的影响
items.abstract_zh: 地球目前正处于大规模森林砍伐与造林共存的时代。大规模农业砍伐及随后造林对土壤生物多样性、生态系统多功能性（EMF）以及土壤生物多样性与EMF（BEF(m)）之间的关系影响尚不明确。我们在这里调查了沿4000公里南北走向横断线的405个成对地块，涵盖热带、亚热带、温带和北方针带。我们测量了19项生态功能和土壤生物群（包括细菌、真菌、古菌、病毒、原生生物和无脊椎动物）和宏基因组的测序。我们发现农业砍伐导致土壤多营养生物多样性减少25%，电磁场层减少58%，造林部分恢复了这些多样性，但尚未达到原始状态。农业森林砍伐使四个气候带间的BEF(m)正相关性脱钩，而造林在热带和亚热带恢复BEF(m)正向关系，但在温带和北带地区则无此变。温暖区的造林会触发潜在的多营养级联反应，增强电磁场，从而加强BEF(m)的关系。造林诱导的生物地球化学循环基因变化对温暖区电磁场的驱动作用比寒冷区更显著。本研究提供了综合证据，表明气候调节BEF(m)的恢复，并提供了关于EMF背后机制的多营养和宏基因组洞见。

items.title: Human imprints on global riverfronts
items.publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
items.abstract: Rivers are profoundly shaped by human activity along their water-land interfaces (riverfronts), yet the global distribution and drivers of these imprints remain poorly understood. Here we present a high-resolution global map of 7.52 million kilometers of riverfronts using satellite imagery and deep learning. We find that nearly 20% of global riverfronts are anthropogenically modified, primarily by agriculture (13.43%) and built-up areas (6.29%). A distinct modification belt spans parts of Africa and Eurasia, accounting for ~60% of global alterations, with imprint densities six times higher than elsewhere. This lateral fragmentation represents a pervasive human pressure that differs fundamentally from dam-induced longitudinal fragmentation, and is closely linked to deteriorating water quality and biodiversity threats. Environmental constraints and region-specific socio-economic dependencies further shape these spatial patterns. Our findings inform riverfront management and underscore the urgent need to reconcile development with the ecological integrity of these transitional zones. The global map of riverfront landscapes reveals that nearly one-fifth of riverfronts have been modified by human activity. This extensive footprint creates widespread fragmentation that fundamentally reshapes land-water interactions, providing crucial insights for rethinking global river management.
items.title_zh: 人类活动在全球河岸留下的印记
items.abstract_zh: 河流的形态在很大程度上受到人类活动在其与水陆交界处的影响的塑造，然而，这些影响的全球分布及其驱动因素仍然知之甚少。在这里，我们利用卫星图像和深度学习技术，绘制出了157.2万公里长的河流岸线的高分辨率全球地图。研究发现，全球约20%的河流岸线受到了人类活动的影响，其中农业活动（13.43%）和人工建筑区域（6.29%）是主要成因。在非洲和欧亚大陆的部分地区，存在一条明显的改造带，该区域占全球河流岸线改造的60%，其改造密度是其他地区的六倍。这种横向的破碎化现象表明，人类活动对这些河流岸线的影响非常显著，这与因大坝建设导致的纵向破碎化现象截然不同。此外，水质恶化以及生物多样性面临的威胁也进一步影响了这些空间格局的形成。环境限制以及不同地区的社会经济依赖性，进一步塑造了这些空间特征。我们的研究发现为河流沿岸的管理提供了重要依据，同时强调了在发展建设与这些过渡地带的生态完整性之间取得平衡的紧迫性。

items.title: The global biogeography of passerine songs
items.publisher: American Association for the Advancement of Science (AAAS)
items.abstract: Although bird songs are classic models for understanding the evolution of vocal communication, their global diversity has long made the development of a unifying framework challenging. By analyzing the acoustic architecture of songs from more than 3000 passerine species worldwide, we show that this acoustic space can be structured around eight elemental motifs. The differential use of these motifs is driven by a combination of species’ biological traits (social organization, morphology, and mating system) and the physics of sound propagation. In tropical rainforests, environmental filtering for transmission efficiency favors structurally simple motifs, such as flat whistles. Conversely, in temperate regions, where high population densities facilitate close-range communication and short breeding seasons intensify sexual selection, the balance shifts toward complex, information-rich motifs, such as ultrafast trills, despite their susceptibility to acoustic degradation. Ultimately, the global geography of birdsong reflects a spatially varying equilibrium between physical environmental constraints and the biological drive for complex communication.
items.title_zh: 雀类鸣叫的全球生物地理分布
items.abstract_zh: 虽然鸟鸣是研究发声交流方式演化的经典研究对象，但由于其全球范围内的多样性，要建立一个统一的分析框架一直颇具挑战性。通过对全球3000多种雀形目鸟类的鸣声进行分析，我们发现，这些鸣声其实可以由八种基本元素构成。这些元素的使用方式因物种的生物学特征（如社会结构、形态和交配方式）以及声音传播的物理规律而有所不同。在热带雨林中，由于声音传播效率受到环境因素的影响，那些结构简单的鸣声更易被传递；而在温带地区，由于人口密度高，鸟类需要更近距离的交流，同时短暂的繁殖季节也加剧了性选择的压力，因此那些结构复杂、包含更多信息的鸣声更受青睐。尽管鸟鸣容易受到声音环境的影响而受损。但从整体来看，全球范围内鸟鸣的分布情况，实际上反映了物理环境因素与生物体进行复杂交流的本能之间的动态平衡。

items.title: Invasive species’ environmental impacts are more severe in the Global South
items.publisher: American Association for the Advancement of Science (AAAS)
items.abstract: Invasive alien species (IAS) are a major threat to biodiversity, yet their impact distribution remains poorly understood. Global biodiversity assessments suggest the highest impacts in wealthy countries of the Global North, but this is only inferred from IAS numbers, reflecting research bias. Using a new global database of standardized impact measures, we calculated average impact severity per country and found that it is higher in the Global South despite more than twice as many reports in the Global North. Weak governance and limited management capacity are the main drivers of high impact severity. Emerging economies with rapid economic growth but poor governance are particularly vulnerable. Failure to recognize the Global South as facing the highest IAS impacts diverts attention away from the most threatened regions.
items.title_zh: 入侵物种对环境造成的破坏，在全球南方地区更为严重
items.abstract_zh: 外来入侵物种是对生物多样性构成的重大威胁，但其具体影响范围至今仍不甚清楚。全球生物多样性评估结果显示，北方富裕国家所受的影响最为严重，但这一结论仅是基于外来入侵物种的数量得出的，其中存在研究偏差。通过利用一个包含标准化影响数据的全球数据库，我们计算出了各国的平均影响程度。结果发现，尽管北方国家关于外来入侵物种的记录数量是南方国家的两倍多，但南方的平均影响程度其实更高。治理不善和管理能力不足是导致南方受影响更严重的主因。那些经济快速增长但治理水平低下的新兴经济体尤其容易受到影响。如果忽视了南方国家所面临的最严重的外来入侵物种威胁，就会使人们无法将注意力集中在那些最需要保护的地区上。

items.title: Emergent patterns of island biodiversity in the Anthropocene
authors: Alexandra A. E. van der Geer
items.publisher: American Association for the Advancement of Science (AAAS)
items.abstract: Islands have long been foundational to the development of ecological and evolutionary theory, serving as model systems for studying patterns of biodiversity. However, pervasive anthropogenic impacts—particularly species extinctions and introductions—have substantially altered island ecosystems, complicating inferences drawn from contemporary data. Here, we review how these human-driven changes have reshaped key biodiversity patterns on islands, including patterns of species richness, community composition, evolution, and species interactions. We show that many current ecological and evolutionary patterns observed on islands reflect not just natural processes but also a legacy of human-induced change spanning millennia. Approaches that better incorporate paleoecological evidence, along with improved island biodiversity databases and modeling techniques, can help better reconstruct prehuman biodiversity baselines on islands.
items.title_zh: 人类世背景下岛屿生物多样性的形成模式
items.abstract_zh: 长期以来，岛屿一直是生态学和进化论研究的重要基础，被用作研究生物多样性模式的理想模型。然而，人类活动对岛屿生态系统的影响极为深远——尤其是物种的灭绝和引入——这些变化极大地扰乱了岛屿上的生态系统，使得基于当前数据得出的结论变得复杂化。本文综述了人类活动如何改变了岛屿上的生物多样性模式，包括物种丰富度、群落组成、物种进化以及物种间的相互作用等方面。研究表明，岛屿上目前观察到的许多生态和进化现象，既受自然过程的影响，也深受人类活动数千年来的影响。如果能够更好地利用古生态学证据，同时改进岛屿生物多样性数据库和建模技术，就能更准确地重建人类出现之前的岛屿生物多样性状况。

items.title: Plant diversity modifies multi-trophic interactions in croplands, grasslands and forests
items.publisher: American Association for the Advancement of Science (AAAS)
items.abstract: Multitrophic interactions can strongly influence the structure and functioning of ecosystems, but how plant diversity influences the direction and predictability of multitrophic interactions across agricultural and natural ecosystems remains unclear. Using 149 field studies across five continents, we found that, on average, increasing plant diversity tended to exert differential top-down and bottom-up effects in croplands versus grasslands and forests. Organic and nonorganic croplands exhibited 846 and 148% higher invertebrate natural enemy-to-herbivore abundance ratios under increased plant diversity, consistent with top-down control patterns where predator gains cause herbivore declines, enhancing crop outcomes. In grasslands and forests, increasing plant diversity was associated with bottom-up effects where enhanced productivity increased both herbivore and predator populations, with the enemy-to-herbivore ratio increasing 4.73% for grasslands and 21.2% for forests. Our findings suggest that biodiversity effects on productivity are not solely explained by direct plant-plant interactions and the resulting biodiversity-productivity relationship. Rather, they reveal patterns consistent with the framework of top-down and bottom-up effects, the relative balance of which may vary depending on ecosystem and management type. The magnitude of the effects of diversified farming on crop pests suggests that crop diversification may be an important avenue for managing crop pests preventatively and thereby enhancing agricultural sustainability.
items.title_zh: 植物多样性会改变农田、草原和森林中的多营养级相互作用关系
items.abstract_zh: 多营养级相互作用会显著影响生态系统的结构和功能。不过，植物多样性如何影响农业和自然生态系统中的多营养级相互作用的方向和可预测性，目前尚不清楚。通过对五大洲的149项野外研究进行分析，我们发现：总体而言，植物多样性的增加在农田、草原和森林中产生的影响各不相同。在农田中，植物多样性增加后，无脊椎动物天敌与食草动物的比例分别增加了846%和148%；这一现象符合“自上而下的控制机制”，即捕食者的增加会导致食草动物数量的减少，从而有利于农作物的生长。而在草原和森林中，植物多样性增加则产生了“自下而上的效应”：生产力的提高使得食草动物和捕食动物的数量都增加了，天敌与食草动物的比例增加了4.73%。其中，21.2%为森林。我们的研究结果表明，生物多样性对生产力的影响并不仅仅取决于植物之间的直接相互作用以及由此产生的生物多样性-生产力关系。相反，这些结果表明，生物多样性的影响符合“自上而下”和“自下而上”两种机制的共同作用结果，而这两种机制的相对重要性则可能因生态系统和管理方式的不同而有所差异。多样化种植方式对农作物害虫的影响表明，通过多样化种植来预防农作物害虫，可能是提升农业可持续性的有效途径。

items.title: Rates of passerine body plan evolution in time and space
items.publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
items.abstract: The rates and patterns of phenotypic evolution are known to vary dramatically across time and space, yet the drivers of this variation remain poorly understood. Using over 170,000 skeletal measurements across 2,057 species of Passeriformes—the most diverse order of living birds—we reconstruct the evolutionary history of passerine body plan diversification over the past ~50 Myr. We find that the history of passerine body plan evolution is dominated by rare, hierarchically nested bursts of phenotypic innovation near the origins of major taxonomic groups, indicating that such radiations have played a disproportionately large role in shaping global passerine diversity. These bursts are temporally aligned with intervals of increased climatic instability in Earth’s history and are reflected in contemporary latitudinal gradients, where assemblages at higher latitudes host species with elevated mean rates of phenotypic evolution and more modular trait covariation. Together, our findings support the hypothesis that climatic variability may act as a recurring driver of phenotypic diversification, linking deep-time pulses of innovation to broad-scale spatial patterns in evolutionary tempo. A reconstruction of the evolutionary history of passerine body plans over the past ~50 Myr shows rare bursts of phenotypic innovation near the origin of major taxonomic groups that are temporally aligned with periods of increased climatic instability. Similar patterns are reflected in contemporary spatial gradients, where higher-latitude and more seasonal environments show elevated phenotypic rates.
items.title_zh: 鸟类身体结构在时间和空间上的演化速率

items.title: Non-native and invasive tree species are abundant in neotropical secondary forest but decline over time
items.publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
items.abstract: Non-native and invasive species are among the leading causes of global biodiversity loss and could therefore compromise the recovery of native forests after disturbance, such as on abandoned agricultural lands. Here we evaluated how the relative density and richness of non-native woody species (NNS) change across secondary tropical forest succession, determined whether they vary between dry and moist forests and identified the underlying environmental and social drivers of these changes. We used data from 1,561 forest plots and 58 chronosequences from ten neotropical countries. We classified 3,735 woody species by origin and invasiveness. Our analyses and conclusions focus on NNS, whereas native (potentially) invasive groups were examined separately. NNS were widespread, occurring in 81% of the chronosequences and comprising 18% of dry and 41% of moist forest plots. We recorded 11 non-native invasive species, most of which were multifunctional trees associated with human activity. In early succession (the first 10–20 years), NNS reached high relative density and richness, accounting for 28% of stems and 22% of species in moist forests, and 9% of stems and species in dry forests. Both metrics declined considerably during the same period but were still present in late succession, mirroring the successional trajectory of native pioneer species, probably due to canopy closure and increased shading. Spatially, NNS richness increased with the Human Development Index. However, both density and richness were negatively affected by increasing surrounding forest cover, agricultural proximity and precipitation, while soil organic carbon generally favoured NNS retention. Our findings suggest that naturally regrowing forests and maintaining relatively intact forest landscapes provide nature-based solutions to control NNS, thereby protecting native biodiversity, ecosystem integrity and local livelihoods. Non-native and invasive trees establish early during the regeneration of secondary forests. However, their decline over time suggests that native forest recovery can limit their abundance. Thus, neotropical secondary forests may buffer tree invasions.
items.title_zh: 在非热带地区的次生森林中，非本地入侵树种非常常见，但随着时间的推移，这些物种的数量会逐渐减少

items.title: Sacred sites as refuges for native plant diversity in an urbanized tropical landscape
items.publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
items.abstract: In fragmented and intensively managed remnant urban green spaces, enabling natural regeneration is crucial to sustain ecosystem functioning and associated services. Natural regeneration therefore offers an important lens into ecological resilience in human-modified landscapes. Here we present one of the most comprehensive field-based assessments of urban plant diversity in the Afrotropics, comprising over 25,000 naturally regenerating woody plant individuals of 206 species (39% native) across 329 vegetation patches in Antananarivo, Madagascar. Landscape-level native species diversity declined with greater building complexity, density and socio-economic development, whereas exotic species showed no consistent associations with determinants of urban characteristics. Native species richness was highest in ‘sacred’ forest fragments, many of which contain historic remains dating back to pre-colonial times. Notably, seven of the ten most species-rich patches were located in such sites. Our findings highlight the potentially important role of these sites in sustaining native species diversity and indicate how socio-cultural factors can present both opportunities and barriers for tropical urban conservation and restoration.
items.title_zh: 在城市化热带环境中，这些神圣的地点可以成为本土植物多样性的避难所
items.abstract_zh: 在那些破碎且管理极为严格的城市绿地中，实现自然再生对于维持生态系统的功能及其相关服务至关重要。因此，自然再生为了解人类改造景观中的生态韧性提供了重要的视角。在这里，我们展示了非洲热带地区最全面的城市植物多样性实地评估结果之一。该评估涵盖了马达加斯加安塔纳纳罗夫地区329个植被斑块中的25,000株自然再生的木本植物，这些植物来自206个物种，其中39%为本地物种。随着建筑结构的复杂性、人口密度以及社会经济发展的增加，景观层面的本地物种多样性有所下降，而外来物种则并未表现出与城市特征之间的明显关联。在“神圣”森林碎片中，本地物种的丰富度最高，其中许多区域还保存着可追溯到殖民前时期的古老遗迹。值得注意的是……在十个物种多样性最丰富的区域中，有七个位于这样的地点。我们的研究发现强调了这些地点在维持本地物种多样性方面可能发挥的重要作用，同时也揭示了社会文化因素如何为热带城市地区的保护与恢复带来机遇与障碍。

items.title: Ecological novelty induced by climate change
items.publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
items.abstract: Climate change is altering the conditions experienced by organisms and ecosystems at a pace unprecedented on geological timescales. The resulting shifts in terrestrial and marine systems fall under the umbrella of ecological novelty, which describes the effects of rapid change at multiple scales. This Review explores the mechanisms behind climate change-induced ecological novelty and its manifestation across global biomes. We contextualize novelty within a deep time perspective of past climate shifts and ecological reorganization. We find ample evidence for the severe disruption of ecological communities from the direct and indirect effects of climate change, and novelty emerging through climate change adaptation and mitigation measures. Potential interventions fall along a gradient of managing against, tolerating or managing for ecological novelty. The authors review ecological novelty—ecological situations with no precedent—arising from climate change. They discuss ecological novelty due to direct and indirect effects of climate change, and due to adaptation and mitigation measures, and explore management options that are against, for or tolerant of ecological novelty.
items.title_zh: 由气候变化引发的生态新现象

items.title: Status, threats and conservation of Earth’s migratory birds
items.publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
items.abstract: Half of all migratory bird species have declining population sizes. Losses span every region on Earth and raise urgent concerns for the long-term persistence of one of the planet’s most visible and ecologically important groups. Without intervention, continued declines and extinctions are inevitable. In this Review, we discuss current trends, threats and conservation responses for migratory birds. The true status of Earth’s migratory birds remains uncertain as monitoring is constrained by technical and financial limitations and geographic biases, particularly in the Global South. Identifying where declines occur and their causes remains challenging because migrants traverse vast ecological and political landscapes, complicating diagnosis and response. Current conservation momentum is focused on area-based and threat-based approaches, yet most migratory birds spend the majority of their life cycles outside protected areas, and threat mitigation remains largely localized, underscoring the need to advance species-level approaches that target limiting factors before populations become threatened. Reversing declines requires a coordinated framework that integrates full annual cycle understanding with human dimensions, expands monitoring, prioritizes landscape-scale habitat protection, delivers targeted threat reduction, and strengthens governance and financing, supported by precautionary action and more effective communication to conserve Earth’s migratory birds. Migratory bird species are globally ubiquitous but rely on diverse habitats and locations across their annual cycles, requiring unique conservation solutions relative to non-migratory birds. This Review discusses population trends of migratory birds, dominant threats in different regions and existing conservation initiatives, then recommends integrative conservation approaches for the future.
items.title_zh: 地球候鸟的现状、威胁与保护

items.title: Declining coccolithophore blooms in the North Atlantic and Western Barents Sea
items.publisher: American Association for the Advancement of Science (AAAS)
items.abstract: Coccolithophores are vital to marine ecosystems and play a central role in the global carbon cycle. Although abundant in the temperate North Atlantic and Barents Sea, their long-term bloom dynamics remain poorly understood. Using two decades of satellite observations, we reveal a substantial decline in coccolithophore blooms between 2003 and 2022, with a 36.1% reduction in bloom area and a 51.2% decrease in bloom frequency. The decline is most pronounced in the temperate North Atlantic and western Barents Sea, while the eastern Barents Sea shows notable increases. Decreasing sea surface temperatures (SSTs) in the North Atlantic and warming in the eastern Barents Sea are identified as key drivers of these trends. However, SST changes alone do not explain the asymmetric patterns across the Barents Sea, suggesting additional environmental drivers and phytoplankton competition. Our study provides the most spatially and temporally resolved assessment of coccolithophore bloom trends in this region to date, with broader implications for marine ecosystems and carbon cycling.
items.title_zh: 北大西洋和西巴伦茨海中的球石藻繁殖现象正在减少
items.abstract_zh: 球石藻对海洋生态系统至关重要，在全球碳循环中发挥着核心作用。虽然这种生物在温带北大西洋和巴伦茨海地区非常丰富，但它们的长期繁殖规律仍不清楚。通过二十年的卫星观测数据，我们发现从2003年到2022年，球石藻的繁殖面积减少了36.1%，繁殖频率则下降了51.2%。这一趋势在温带北大西洋和巴伦茨海西部最为明显，而巴伦茨海东部则出现了明显的增长。北大西洋海面温度下降以及巴伦茨海东部气温升高被认为是导致这些变化的关键因素。然而，单凭海面温度的变化无法解释巴伦茨海地区的这种不对称现象，这表明还有其他环境因素以及浮游植物的竞争在起作用。我们的研究提供了迄今为止对该地区球石藻繁殖趋势最精确的空间和时间上的评估，这对海洋生态系统和碳循环有着重要的意义。

items.title: Beyond the scales: Marine archaeogenomics for the conservation and restoration of fisheries
items.publisher: American Association for the Advancement of Science (AAAS)
items.abstract: Protection and restoration of marine environments are essential for food security and climate change mitigation. Yet historical and archaeological research have shown that conservation and management often rely on arbitrary ecological baselines in ecosystems already shaped by long-term human impacts. Archaeogenomics, the combination of ancient DNA (aDNA) and whole-genome sequencing, provides invaluable insights into these impacts. Recent improvements in laboratory and computational techniques enable the assessment of past fish population dynamics, migration patterns, historical trade routes, long-term anthropogenic pressures, and responses to environmental change. This Review compiles aDNA research on archaeological fish remains, emphasizing studies from 2020 to 2025 that used whole-genome analysis to investigate historical fisheries and marine ecosystem change. We highlight the growing potential of archaeogenomics to inform restoration, conservation, sustainable fisheries management, and climate adaptation strategies worldwide.
